  Nat.recAux (motive := fun n =>
    ∀ (a : ℝ),
      MultiStepSeparation.iterUpdate (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1)
          (Matrix.of fun r c => if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then a else 0) (MultiStepSeparation.zeroSteps n) =
        Matrix.of fun r c => if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter n a else 0)
    (fun a =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun x => (Matrix.of fun r c => if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then a else 0) = Matrix.of x)
            (funext fun r =>
              funext fun c =>
                ite_congr (Eq.refl (r = 0 ∧ c = 0)) (fun a_1 => Eq.refl a) fun a => Eq.refl 0))
          (eq_self (Matrix.of fun r c => if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then a else 0))))
    (fun n ih a =>
      id
        (have hstep :=
          Matrix.ext fun i j =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a = Matrix.of (fun r c => if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then Real.tanh a else 0) i j)
                  (MultiStepSeparation.emender_zero_step_on_clean_state a i j)))
              (if h : i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (ite_cond_eq_true (Real.tanh a) 0
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congr
                              (congrArg And (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x = 0) h.1) (eq_self 0)))
                              (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x = 0) h.2) (eq_self 0)))
                            (and_self True))))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congr
                          (congrArg (Matrix.of fun r c => if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then Real.tanh a else 0)
                            h.1)
                          h.2)
                        (ite_cond_eq_true (Real.tanh a) 0
                          (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg And (eq_self 0)) (eq_self 0))
                            (and_self True)))))
                    (eq_self (Real.tanh a)))
              else
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr (congrArg Eq (ite_cond_eq_false (Real.tanh a) 0 (eq_false h)))
                      (ite_cond_eq_false (Real.tanh a) 0 (eq_false h)))
                    (eq_self 0)));
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                MultiStepSeparation.iterUpdate (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1) _a
                    (MultiStepSeparation.zeroSteps n) =
                  Matrix.of fun r c =>
                    if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter (n + 1) a else 0)
              hstep))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a =
                    Matrix.of fun r c =>
                      if r = 0 ∧ c = 0 then MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter (n + 1) a else 0)
                (ih (Real.tanh a))))
            (Matrix.ext fun i j =>
              if h : i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congr
                            (congr
                              (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                                (funext fun r =>
                                  funext fun c =>
                                    ite_congr (Eq.refl (r = 0 ∧ c = 0))
                                      (fun a_1 => MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter_tanh_comm n a)
                                      fun a => Eq.refl 0))
                              h.1)
                            h.2)
                          (ite_cond_eq_true (Real.tanh (MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter n a)) 0
                            (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg And (eq_self 0)) (eq_self 0))
                              (and_self True)))))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congr
                          (congr
                            (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                              (funext fun r =>
                                funext fun c =>
                                  ite_congr (Eq.refl (r = 0 ∧ c = 0))
                                    (fun a_1 =>
                                      Eq.refl (Real.tanh (MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter n a)))
                                    fun a => Eq.refl 0))
                            h.1)
                          h.2)
                        (ite_cond_eq_true (Real.tanh (MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter n a)) 0
                          (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg And (eq_self 0)) (eq_self 0))
                            (and_self True)))))
                    (eq_self (Real.tanh (MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter n a))))
              else
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (ite_cond_eq_false (MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter n (Real.tanh a)) 0
                          (eq_false h)))
                      (ite_cond_eq_false (MultiStepSeparation.tanhIter (n + 1) a) 0 (eq_false h)))
                    (eq_self 0))))))
    n a

/-- Entry `(0, 0)` of the k-step NDM trajectory on the witness is
`tanhIter k (-1)` for every `k ≥ 1`. -/
theorem iterUpdate_emender_kStep_entry
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    iterUpdate (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1)
        lowerLeftState (kStepWitnessInputs k) 0 0
      = tanhIter k (-1) := by
  unfold kStepWitnessInputs
  simp only [iterUpdate]
  rw [emender_step1_clean_matrix, emender_iter_zero_clean]
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply, and_self, if_true]
  -- After rewriting, goal: tanhIter (k - 1) (Real.tanh (-1)) = tanhIter k (-1)
  rw [tanhIter_tanh_comm]
  -- Goal: Real.tanh (tanhIter (k - 1) (-1)) = tanhIter k (-1)
  have heq : tanhIter k (-1) = Real.tanh (tanhIter (k - 1) (-1)) := by
    have : k = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    conv_lhs => rw [this]
    rfl
  exact heq.symm

/-- **k-step separation theorem (extension of Milestone 1).**

For every `k ≥ 1` and every fixed-right raw-write M2RNN-style resource, the
`k`-step trajectory of the resource on the witness input differs from NDM's
`k`-step trajectory on the same input. The distinguishing entry is `(0, 0)`:

* NDM produces `tanhIter k (-1)`, nonzero for every `k ≥ 0` (by injectivity).
* The resource produces exactly `0`, by row-0 zero preservation.

The witness input is `kStepWitnessInputs k = [(mixedKey, 0), (0, 0), …, (0, 0)]`
(length `k`) starting from `lowerLeftState`.

This shows the one-step separation does not wash out over composition: it
strictly persists for every finite length. The result generalizes
`emender_m2rnn_two_step_separation` and constitutes the cleanest Lean ceiling
reachable on the multi-step composition axis. -/
theorem emender_m2rnn_k_step_separation
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (resource : FixedRightRawExternalForget2) :
    iterUpdate resource.update lowerLeftState (kStepWitnessInputs k) ≠
      iterUpdate (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1)
        lowerLeftState (kStepWitnessInputs k) := by
  intro hEq
  have hEntry := congrFun (congrFun hEq 0) 0
  rw [iterUpdate_m2rnn_kStep_entry_zero resource k hk,
      iterUpdate_emender_kStep_entry k hk] at hEntry
  exact tanhIter_ne_zero_of_ne_zero k (-1) (by norm_num) hEntry.symm

/-- **k-step separation in existential form.** For every `k ≥ 1` and every
fixed-right raw-write resource, there is a `k`-token input sequence on which
the `k`-step composition differs from NDM. -/
theorem emender_m2rnn_k_step_separation_exists
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (resource : FixedRightRawExternalForget2) :
    ∃ (H0 : TwoMat) (inputs : List (TwoVec × TwoVec)),
      inputs.length = k ∧
      iterUpdate resource.update H0 inputs ≠
        iterUpdate (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1) H0 inputs := by
  refine ⟨lowerLeftState, kStepWitnessInputs k, ?_,
    emender_m2rnn_k_step_separation k hk resource⟩
  -- Length of kStepWitnessInputs k is k for k ≥ 1.
  unfold kStepWitnessInputs
  have hlen : (zeroSteps (k - 1)).length = k - 1 := by
    induction (k - 1) with
    | zero => simp [zeroSteps]
    | succ n ih => simp [zeroSteps, List.length_cons, ih]
  simp [List.length_cons, hlen]
  omega

/-- Row 0 of the M2RNN candidate is zero in KV when row 0 of `H` is zero and
`v = 0`. -/
theorem m2rnnCandidate_row0_zero_at_zero_row_KV
    (W : Matrix (Fin V) (Fin V) Real) (k : Vec K)
    (H : MatState K V)
    (hrow : ∀ j, H (i0 hK) j = 0) (j : Fin V) :
    m2rnnCandidate W H k (0 : Vec V) (i0 hK) j = 0 := by
  simp [m2rnnCandidate, matrixTanh, matrixMap, outerKV,
    Matrix.mul_apply, hrow]
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (W : Matrix (Fin V) (Fin V) ℝ) (k : M2RNNComparison.Vec K)
  (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
  (∀ (j : Fin V), H (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0) →
    ∀ (j : Fin V), M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate W H k 0 (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} hK W k H hrow j =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (fun x => x = 0)
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun x => Matrix.of x (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j)
            (funext fun i =>
              funext fun j =>
                congrArg Real.tanh
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (fun x => (H * W + Matrix.of x) i j)
                      (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero (k i)))
                    (add_zero (∑ j_1, H i j_1 * W j_1 j)))))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg Real.tanh
              (Eq.trans
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 * W x j) ((fun j => hrow j) x))
                    (zero_mul (W x j)))
                Finset.sum_const_zero))
            Real.tanh_zero)))
      (eq_self 0))

theorem m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero
    (W : Matrix (Fin V) (Fin V) Real) (r : Vec K) (k : Vec K)
    (H : MatState K V)
    (hrow : ∀ j, H (i0 hK) j = 0) (j : Fin V) :
    m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV W r H k (0 : Vec V) (i0 hK) j = 0 := by
  have hcand : m2rnnCandidate W H k (0 : Vec V) (i0 hK) j = 0 :=
    m2rnnCandidate_row0_zero_at_zero_row_KV hK W k H hrow j
  simp [m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV, rowForgetCarryKV, hrow, hcand]
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (W : Matrix (Fin V) (Fin V) ℝ) (r k : M2RNNComparison.Vec K)
  (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),

  have hcand := MultiStepSeparation.m2rnnCandidate_row0_zero_at_zero_row_KV hK W k H hrow j;
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (fun x => x = 0)
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
              (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (r (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK))) ((fun j => hrow j) j))
                (mul_zero (r (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK)))))
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (1 - r (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK))) hcand)
              (mul_zero (1 - r (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK)))))
          (add_zero 0)))
      (eq_self 0))

/-- Generic zero-row preservation for the KV resource class. -/
theorem FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV_preserves_zero_row
    (resource : FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V)
    (k : Vec K) (H : MatState K V)
    (hrow : ∀ j, H (i0 hK) j = 0) (j : Fin V) :
    resource.update H k (0 : Vec V) (i0 hK) j = 0 := by
  cases resource with
  | row W r => exact m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero hK W r k H hrow j
  | column W c => exact m2rnnColumnForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero hK W c k H hrow j
  | cell W g => exact m2rnnCellForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero hK W g k H hrow j
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (resource : RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V)
  (k : M2RNNComparison.Vec K) (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
  (∀ (j : Fin V), H (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0) →
    ∀ (j : Fin V), resource.update H k 0 (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} hK resource k H hrow j =>
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
    resource = t → resource.update H k 0 (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0) resource
    (fun W r h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸ MultiStepSeparation.m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero hK W r k H hrow j)
    (fun W c h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸ MultiStepSeparation.m2rnnColumnForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero hK W c k H hrow j)
    (fun W g h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸ MultiStepSeparation.m2rnnCellForgetUpdateKV_row0_zero hK W g k H hrow j)
    (Eq.refl resource)
theorems.name: MultiStepSeparation.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV_preserves_zero_row
theorems.doc: Generic zero-row preservation for the KV resource class.

/-- Iterated KV update over a list of inputs. -/
def iterUpdateKV (update : OneStepUpdateKV K V) (H : MatState K V) :
    List (Vec K × Vec V) → MatState K V
  | [] => H
  | (k, v) :: rest => iterUpdateKV update (update H k v) rest

{K V : ℕ} →
  MultiStepSeparation.OneStepUpdateKV K V →
    M2RNNComparison.MatState K V →
      List (M2RNNComparison.Vec K × M2RNNComparison.Vec V) → M2RNNComparison.MatState K V
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} update H x =>
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => M2RNNComparison.MatState K V → M2RNNComparison.MatState K V) x
    (fun x f H =>
      (match (motive :=
          (x : List (M2RNNComparison.Vec K × M2RNNComparison.Vec V)) →
            List.below (motive := fun x =>
                M2RNNComparison.MatState K V → M2RNNComparison.MatState K V) x →
              M2RNNComparison.MatState K V)
          x with
        | [] => fun x => H
        | (k, v) :: rest => fun x => x.1 (update H k v))
        f)
    H

/-- Iterating any KV M2RNN resource over zero-input steps preserves zero-row-0. -/
theorem iterUpdateKV_zeroSteps_preserves_row0
    (resource : FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V)
    (H : MatState K V) (hrow : ∀ j, H (i0 hK) j = 0) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin V) :
    iterUpdateKV resource.update H (zeroStepsKV K V n) (i0 hK) j = 0 := by
  induction n generalizing H with
  | zero => simpa [iterUpdateKV, zeroStepsKV] using hrow j
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [zeroStepsKV, iterUpdateKV]
    apply ih
    intro j'
    exact FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV_preserves_zero_row hK resource
      (0 : Vec K) H hrow j'
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (resource : RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V)
  (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
  (∀ (j : Fin V), H (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0) →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin V),
      MultiStepSeparation.iterUpdateKV resource.update H (MultiStepSeparation.zeroStepsKV K V n)
          (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j =
        0
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} hK resource H hrow n j =>
  Nat.recAux (motive := fun n =>
    ∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
      (∀ (j : Fin V), H (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j = 0) →
        MultiStepSeparation.iterUpdateKV resource.update H (MultiStepSeparation.zeroStepsKV K V n)
            (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK) j =
          0)
    (fun H hrow => id (hrow j))
    (fun n ih H hrow =>
      id
        (ih (resource.update H 0 0) fun j' =>
          MultiStepSeparation.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV_preserves_zero_row hK resource 0 H hrow
            j'))
    n H hrow

/-- Entry `(i₀, j₀)` of the k-step KV M2RNN trajectory on the embedded witness
is `0` for every `k ≥ 1`. -/
theorem iterUpdateKV_m2rnn_kStep_entry_zero
    (resource : FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    iterUpdateKV resource.update (embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV)
        (kStepWitnessInputsKV hK k) (i0 hK) (j0 hV) = 0 := by
  unfold kStepWitnessInputsKV
  simp only [iterUpdateKV]
  have hrow0 : ∀ j, embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV (i0 hK) j = 0 :=
    embeddedLowerLeftState_row0 hK hV
  have hrow1 : ∀ j, resource.update (embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV)
      (embeddedMixedKey hK) (0 : Vec V) (i0 hK) j = 0 := by
    intro j
    exact FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV_preserves_zero_row hK resource
      (embeddedMixedKey hK) (embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV) hrow0 j
  exact iterUpdateKV_zeroSteps_preserves_row0 hK resource
    (resource.update (embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV)
      (embeddedMixedKey hK) (0 : Vec V)) hrow1 (k - 1) (j0 hV)
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (hV : 0 < V)
  (resource : RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V) (k : ℕ),
  1 ≤ k →
    MultiStepSeparation.iterUpdateKV resource.update
        (RecurrentResourceFormalism.embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV)
        (MultiStepSeparation.kStepWitnessInputsKV hK k) (MultiStepSeparation.i0 hK)
        (MultiStepSeparation.j0 hV) =
      0
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} hK hV resource k hk =>
  id
    (id
      (have hrow0 := MultiStepSeparation.embeddedLowerLeftState_row0 hK hV;
      have hrow1 := fun j =>
        MultiStepSeparation.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV_preserves_zero_row hK resource
          (RecurrentResourceFormalism.embeddedMixedKey hK)
          (RecurrentResourceFormalism.embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV) hrow0 j;
      MultiStepSeparation.iterUpdateKV_zeroSteps_preserves_row0 hK resource
        (resource.update (RecurrentResourceFormalism.embeddedLowerLeftState hK hV)
          (RecurrentResourceFormalism.embeddedMixedKey hK) 0)
        hrow1 (k - 1) (MultiStepSeparation.j0 hV)))

/-- Raw outer-product write:

`S' = S + k v^T`.

This is the common raw associative-memory core. It can add an association, but
without state-dependent correction it does not implement overwrite for arbitrary
existing memory.
-/
def rawOuterWrite
    (S : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) : Memory K V :=
  S + M2RNNComparison.outerKV k v

/-- Reads distribute over matrix addition. -/
theorem read_add
    (A B : Memory K V) (q : KeyVec K) :
    read (A + B) q = read A q + read B q := by
  ext j
  simp [read, M2RNNComparison.queryReadout, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  calc
    Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => (A x j + B x j) * q x)
        =
      Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => A x j * q x + B x j * q x) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => A x j * q x) +
      Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => B x j * q x) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- Reading an outer-product write returns the written value scaled by key
overlap. -/
theorem read_outerKV
    (k q : KeyVec K) (e : ValueVec V) :
    read (M2RNNComparison.outerKV k e) q =
      fun j => keyDot k q * e j := by
  ext j
  simp [read, M2RNNComparison.queryReadout, M2RNNComparison.outerKV,
    keyDot, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  calc
    Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => k x * e j * q x)
        = Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => (k x * q x) * e j) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
    _ = (Finset.univ.sum fun i : Fin K => k i * q i) * e j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = (Finset.univ.sum fun i : Fin K => k i * q i) * e j := rfl

/-- Delta write changes a query in proportion to its overlap with the write key. -/
theorem read_linearDeltaWrite
    (S : Memory K V) (k q : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) :
    read (linearDeltaWrite S k v) q =
      read S q + fun j => keyDot k q * correction S k v j := by
  ext j
  simp [linearDeltaWrite, read, correction, M2RNNComparison.queryReadout,
    M2RNNComparison.outerKV, keyDot, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  calc
    Finset.univ.sum
        (fun x : Fin K => (S x j + k x * (v j - Finset.univ.sum (fun x => S x j * k x))) * q x)
        =
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun x : Fin K =>
          S x j * q x + (k x * q x) * (v j - Finset.univ.sum (fun x => S x j * k x))) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => S x j * q x) +
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun x : Fin K => (k x * q x) * (v j - Finset.univ.sum (fun x => S x j * k x))) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => S x j * q x) +
      (Finset.univ.sum fun i : Fin K => k i * q i) *
        (v j - Finset.univ.sum (fun x => S x j * k x)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]

/-- Raw outer-product write changes a query in proportion to key overlap, but it
does not subtract existing retrieved content. -/
theorem read_rawOuterWrite
    (S : Memory K V) (k q : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) :
    read (rawOuterWrite S k v) q =
      read S q + fun j => keyDot k q * v j := by
  rw [rawOuterWrite, read_add, read_outerKV]

/-- With a unit key, raw writing reads back "old content plus new value". -/
theorem rawOuterWrite_reads_existing_plus_value_unit
    (S : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V)
    (hk : keyDot k k = 1) :
    read (rawOuterWrite S k v) k = read S k + v := by
  rw [read_rawOuterWrite]
  ext j
  simp [hk]

∀ {K V : ℕ} (S : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K) (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V),

  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = OnlineMemory.read S k + v)

    (funext fun j =>

            (funext fun j => Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x * v j) hk) (one_mul (v j))))
          (eq_self (OnlineMemory.read S k j + v j))))

slot already contains nonzero content. -/

    (S : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V)
    (hk : keyDot k k = 1) (j : Fin V)

    read (rawOuterWrite S k v) k ≠ v := by
  intro h
  rw [rawOuterWrite_reads_existing_plus_value_unit S k v hk] at h
  have hj := congrFun h j
  change read S k j + v j = v j at hj
  have hz : read S k j = 0 := by
    linarith
  exact hprev hz

theorems.source_text:
/-- More generally, no state-independent additive write can overwrite two old
memories that disagree at the addressed key in one step.

This is the resource-separation hook: to implement overwrite uniformly, the
write term must either depend on the old state, add extra machinery, or use
additional steps/resources to infer and cancel the old content. -/
theorem stateIndependentAdditiveWrite_cannot_exact_overwrite_two_memories
    (term : KeyVec K → ValueVec V → Memory K V)
    (S₁ S₂ : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) (j : Fin V)
    (hread : read S₁ k j ≠ read S₂ k j) :
    ¬ (read (stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term S₁ k v) k = v ∧
       read (stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term S₂ k v) k = v) := by
  intro h
  simp [stateIndependentAdditiveWrite, read_add] at h
  have h₁ := congrFun h.1 j
  have h₂ := congrFun h.2 j
  change read S₁ k j + read (term k v) k j = v j at h₁
  change read S₂ k j + read (term k v) k j = v j at h₂
  have heq : read S₁ k j = read S₂ k j := by
    linarith
  exact hread heq
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (term : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K → OnlineMemory.ValueVec V → OnlineMemory.Memory K V)
  (S₁ S₂ : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K) (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V)
  (j : Fin V),
  OnlineMemory.read S₁ k j ≠ OnlineMemory.read S₂ k j →
    ¬(OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term S₁ k v) k = v ∧
        OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term S₂ k v) k = v)
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} term S₁ S₂ k v j hread h =>
  have h₁ :=
    congrFun
      (Eq.mp
          (congr (congrArg (fun x => And (x = v)) (OnlineMemory.read_add S₁ (term k v) k))

theorems.name: OnlineMemory.stateIndependentAdditiveWrite_cannot_exact_overwrite_two_memories
theorems.doc:
More generally, no state-independent additive write can overwrite two old
memories that disagree at the addressed key in one step.

This is the resource-separation hook: to implement overwrite uniformly, the
write term must either depend on the old state, add extra machinery, or use
additional steps/resources to infer and cancel the old content.

/-- Unit-key delta write exactly overwrites the addressed readout. -/
theorem linearDeltaWrite_exact_overwrite
    (S : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V)
    (hk : keyDot k k = 1) :
    read (linearDeltaWrite S k v) k = v := by
  rw [read_linearDeltaWrite]
  ext j
  simp [correction, hk]
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (S : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K) (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V),
  OnlineMemory.keyDot k k = 1 → OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite S k v) k = v
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} S k v hk =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = v) (OnlineMemory.read_linearDeltaWrite S k k v)))
    (funext fun j =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun x => x = v j)
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun x => (OnlineMemory.read S k + x) j)
                (funext fun j =>
                  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x * (v j - OnlineMemory.read S k j)) hk)
                    (one_mul (v j - OnlineMemory.read S k j))))
              (add_sub_cancel (OnlineMemory.read S k j) (v j))))
          (eq_self (v j))))

/-- Orthogonal queries are preserved by a delta write. -/
theorem linearDeltaWrite_preserves_orthogonal_query
    (S : Memory K V) (k q : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V)
    (horth : keyDot k q = 0) :
    read (linearDeltaWrite S k v) q = read S q := by
  rw [read_linearDeltaWrite]
  ext j
  simp [horth]

∀ {K V : ℕ} (S : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k q : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K)
  (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V),
  OnlineMemory.keyDot k q = 0 →
    OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite S k v) q = OnlineMemory.read S q
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} S k q v horth =>

    (id

              (congrArg (fun x => (OnlineMemory.read S q + x) j)
                (funext fun j =>
                  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x * OnlineMemory.correction S k v j) horth)
                    (zero_mul (OnlineMemory.correction S k v j))))
              (add_zero (OnlineMemory.read S q j))))
          (eq_self (OnlineMemory.read S q j))))

/-- Orthonormal keys support exact finite-table retrieval. This is the capacity
upper bound shared by ideal GDN-style delta memory and E88/NDM's pre-tanh delta
core: `N` orthogonal keys can store `N` independent value vectors in a matrix
state. -/
theorem memoryTable_retrieves_orthonormal {N : Nat}
    (keys : Fin N → KeyVec K) (values : Fin N → ValueVec V)
    (horth : OrthonormalKeys keys) :
    ∀ j, read (memoryTable keys values) (keys j) = values j := by
  intro j
  ext dim
  simp [memoryTable, read, M2RNNComparison.queryReadout,
    M2RNNComparison.outerKV, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.of_apply,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  calc
    Finset.univ.sum
        (fun x : Fin K => (Finset.univ.sum fun i : Fin N =>
          keys i x * values i dim) * keys j x)
        =
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun x : Fin K => Finset.univ.sum fun i : Fin N =>
          values i dim * keys i x * keys j x) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun i : Fin N => Finset.univ.sum fun x : Fin K =>
          values i dim * keys i x * keys j x) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun i : Fin N => values i dim *
          Finset.univ.sum (fun x : Fin K => keys i x * keys j x)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          ring
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun i : Fin N => values i dim * keyDot (keys i) (keys j)) := by
          rfl
    _ =
      Finset.univ.sum
        (fun i : Fin N => values i dim * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [horth i j]
    _ = values j dim := by
          rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single j]
          · simp
          · intro i hi
            simp [hi]
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V N : ℕ} (keys : Fin N → OnlineMemory.KeyVec K) (values : Fin N → OnlineMemory.ValueVec V),
  OnlineMemory.OrthonormalKeys keys →
    ∀ (j : Fin N), OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.memoryTable keys values) (keys j) = values j
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V N} keys values horth j =>
  funext fun dim =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun x => x = values j dim)
          (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
            congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 * keys j x)
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1.transpose dim x)
                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                    Eq.refl (Matrix.of fun i j => keys x i * values x j)))
                (Eq.trans
                  (Matrix.sum_apply x dim Finset.univ fun c =>
                    Matrix.of fun i j => keys c i * values c j)
                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x_1 a =>
                    Eq.refl (keys x_1 x * values x_1 dim)))))))
      (Trans.trans
        (Trans.trans
          (Trans.trans
            (Trans.trans
              (Trans.trans
                (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x a =>
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ∑ i, values i dim * keys i x * keys j x)
                        (Finset.sum_mul Finset.univ (fun i => keys i x * values i dim) (keys j x))))
                    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i a =>
                      Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.mul_congr
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.mul_congr (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.atom_pf (keys i x))
                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.atom_pf (values i dim))

                              (keys i x ^ Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                  (values i dim ^ Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                    (keys j x ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1)) +

                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.mul_congr

                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.atom_pf (keys j x))
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.add_mul
                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.mul_add

                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ∑ i, ∑ x, values i dim * keys i x * keys j x)
                      Finset.sum_comm))
                  (Eq.refl (∑ y, ∑ x, values y dim * keys y x * keys j x))))

/-- Online extension step: if `S` already stores an orthogonal family of keys,
a delta write to a new orthogonal unit key stores the new value and preserves
all existing readouts. This is the induction step behind online associative
memory. -/
theorem linearDeltaWrite_extends_orthogonal_readouts {N : Nat}
    (S : Memory K V) (keys : Fin N → KeyVec K) (values : Fin N → ValueVec V)
    (newKey : KeyVec K) (newValue : ValueVec V)
    (hunit : keyDot newKey newKey = 1)
    (horth : ∀ i, keyDot newKey (keys i) = 0)
    (hstored : ∀ i, read S (keys i) = values i) :
    read (linearDeltaWrite S newKey newValue) newKey = newValue ∧
    ∀ i, read (linearDeltaWrite S newKey newValue) (keys i) = values i := by
  constructor
  · exact linearDeltaWrite_exact_overwrite S newKey newValue hunit
  · intro i
    rw [linearDeltaWrite_preserves_orthogonal_query S newKey (keys i) newValue (horth i)]
    exact hstored i
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V N : ℕ} (S : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (keys : Fin N → OnlineMemory.KeyVec K)
  (values : Fin N → OnlineMemory.ValueVec V) (newKey : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K)
  (newValue : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V),
  OnlineMemory.keyDot newKey newKey = 1 →
    (∀ (i : Fin N), OnlineMemory.keyDot newKey (keys i) = 0) →
      (∀ (i : Fin N), OnlineMemory.read S (keys i) = values i) →
        OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite S newKey newValue) newKey = newValue ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin N),
            OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite S newKey newValue) (keys i) = values i

fun {K V N} S keys values newKey newValue hunit horth hstored =>
  ⟨OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite_exact_overwrite S newKey newValue hunit, fun i =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = values i)
          (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite_preserves_orthogonal_query S newKey (keys i) newValue
            (horth i))))
      (hstored i)⟩

/-- Online overwrite step for an orthonormal table: rewriting one key replaces
only that key and preserves every other key. -/
theorem linearDeltaWrite_overwrites_one_preserves_others {N : Nat}
    (keys : Fin N → KeyVec K) (values : Fin N → ValueVec V)
    (horth : OrthonormalKeys keys) (target : Fin N) (newValue : ValueVec V) :
    read (linearDeltaWrite (memoryTable keys values) (keys target) newValue)
        (keys target) = newValue ∧
    ∀ i, i ≠ target →
      read (linearDeltaWrite (memoryTable keys values) (keys target) newValue)
        (keys i) = values i := by
  have hunit : keyDot (keys target) (keys target) = 1 := by
    have h := horth target target
    simpa using h
  constructor
  · exact linearDeltaWrite_exact_overwrite (memoryTable keys values) (keys target) newValue hunit
  · intro i hi
    have horth_i : keyDot (keys target) (keys i) = 0 := by
      have h := horth target i
      simp [hi.symm] at h
      exact h
    rw [linearDeltaWrite_preserves_orthogonal_query
      (memoryTable keys values) (keys target) (keys i) newValue horth_i]
    exact memoryTable_retrieves_orthonormal keys values horth i

      OnlineMemory.read
            (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite (OnlineMemory.memoryTable keys values) (keys target)
              newValue)
            (keys target) =
          newValue ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin N),
          i ≠ target →
            OnlineMemory.read
                (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite (OnlineMemory.memoryTable keys values) (keys target)
                  newValue)
                (keys i) =

fun {K V N} keys values horth target newValue =>
  have hunit :=
    have h := horth target target;
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (Eq (OnlineMemory.keyDot (keys target) (keys target)))
        (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self target)))
      h;
  ⟨OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite_exact_overwrite (OnlineMemory.memoryTable keys values)
      (keys target) newValue hunit,
    fun i hi =>
    have horth_i :=
      have h := horth target i;
      Eq.mp
        (congrArg (Eq (OnlineMemory.keyDot (keys target) (keys i)))
          (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false (Ne.symm hi))))
        h;
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = values i)
          (OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite_preserves_orthogonal_query
            (OnlineMemory.memoryTable keys values) (keys target) (keys i) newValue horth_i)))

/-- Uniform one-step overwrite: for every old memory, every unit key, and every
desired value, one write makes that key read as the desired value. -/

/-- The two uniform obligations are exactly the data needed to package a write
function as a one-step overwrite spec. -/
theorem exists_oneStepOverwriteSpec_iff_uniform_obligations
    (write : Memory K V → KeyVec K → ValueVec V → Memory K V) :
    (∃ spec : OneStepOverwriteSpec K V, spec.write = write) ↔
    UniformOneStepOverwrite write ∧
    UniformOrthogonalPreservation write := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨spec, hwrite⟩
    rw [← hwrite]
    exact oneStepOverwriteSpec_has_uniform_obligations spec
  · intro h
    refine ⟨{
      write := write
      exactOverwrite := ?_
      preservesOrthogonal := ?_
    }, rfl⟩
    · exact h.1
    · exact h.2

∀ {K V : ℕ}
  (write :
    OnlineMemory.Memory K V →
      OnlineMemory.KeyVec K → OnlineMemory.ValueVec V → OnlineMemory.Memory K V),
  (∃ spec, spec.write = write) ↔
    OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite write ∧ OnlineMemory.UniformOrthogonalPreservation write
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} write =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun spec hwrite =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite _a ∧
                  OnlineMemory.UniformOrthogonalPreservation _a)
              (Eq.symm hwrite)))
          (OnlineMemory.oneStepOverwriteSpec_has_uniform_obligations spec),
    mpr := fun h =>
      Exists.intro { write := write, exactOverwrite := h.left, preservesOrthogonal := h.right }
        rfl }

/-- A state-independent additive write cannot satisfy the same uniform overwrite
target when there exist two old memories with different content at the addressed
key.

This is the spec-level separation: delta memory satisfies the uniform one-step
overwrite obligation; raw/state-independent additive writes cannot satisfy it
uniformly unless the old addressed content is somehow already fixed or canceled
by extra machinery. -/

    (term : KeyVec K → ValueVec V → Memory K V)
    (S₁ S₂ : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) (j : Fin V)
    (hunit : keyDot k k = 1)
    (hread : read S₁ k j ≠ read S₂ k j) :
    ¬ UniformOneStepOverwrite (K := K) (V := V)
      (stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term) := by
  intro hspec
  exact stateIndependentAdditiveWrite_cannot_exact_overwrite_two_memories
    term S₁ S₂ k v j hread ⟨hspec S₁ k v hunit, hspec S₂ k v hunit⟩

  (S₁ S₂ : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K) (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V)
  (j : Fin V),
  OnlineMemory.keyDot k k = 1 →
    OnlineMemory.read S₁ k j ≠ OnlineMemory.read S₂ k j →
      ¬OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite (OnlineMemory.stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term)

fun {K V} term S₁ S₂ k v j hunit hread hspec =>

    hread ⟨hspec S₁ k v hunit, hspec S₂ k v hunit⟩

/-- The raw outer-product association primitive used by M2RNN-style matrix
state updates cannot be a uniform one-step overwrite memory when two old
memories disagree at the addressed key. -/
theorem rawOuterWrite_not_uniformOneStepOverwrite
    (S₁ S₂ : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) (j : Fin V)
    (hunit : keyDot k k = 1)
    (hread : read S₁ k j ≠ read S₂ k j) :
    ¬ UniformOneStepOverwrite (K := K) (V := V) rawOuterWrite := by
  intro hspec
  let term : KeyVec K → ValueVec V → Memory K V :=
    fun k v => M2RNNComparison.outerKV k v
  have h₁ :
      read (stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term S₁ k v) k = v := by
    simpa [term, stateIndependentAdditiveWrite, rawOuterWrite]
      using hspec S₁ k v hunit
  have h₂ :
      read (stateIndependentAdditiveWrite term S₂ k v) k = v := by
    simpa [term, stateIndependentAdditiveWrite, rawOuterWrite]
      using hspec S₂ k v hunit
  exact stateIndependentAdditiveWrite_cannot_exact_overwrite_two_memories
    term S₁ S₂ k v j hread ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (S₁ S₂ : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K)
  (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V) (j : Fin V),
  OnlineMemory.keyDot k k = 1 →
    OnlineMemory.read S₁ k j ≠ OnlineMemory.read S₂ k j →
      ¬OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite OnlineMemory.rawOuterWrite

theorems.doc:

theorems.source_text:
/-- Memory-semantics separation for the direct comparison with M2RNN:
GDN's ideal delta core and E88/NDM's pre-tanh delta core satisfy uniform
one-step overwrite, while M2RNN's raw association primitive cannot satisfy that
same target without extra state-dependent correction or other machinery. -/
theorem delta_core_separates_gdn_emender_from_m2rnn_raw_write
    (S₁ S₂ : Memory K V) (k : KeyVec K) (v : ValueVec V) (j : Fin V)
    (hunit : keyDot k k = 1)
    (hread : read S₁ k j ≠ read S₂ k j) :
    UniformOneStepOverwrite (K := K) (V := V) gdnIdealWrite ∧
    UniformOneStepOverwrite (K := K) (V := V) emenderPreTanhWrite ∧
    ¬ UniformOneStepOverwrite (K := K) (V := V) rawOuterWrite := by
  constructor
  · exact gdnIdealWrite_uniformOneStepOverwrite
  constructor
  · exact emenderPreTanhWrite_uniformOneStepOverwrite
  · exact rawOuterWrite_not_uniformOneStepOverwrite S₁ S₂ k v j hunit hread
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (S₁ S₂ : OnlineMemory.Memory K V) (k : OnlineMemory.KeyVec K)
  (v : OnlineMemory.ValueVec V) (j : Fin V),
  OnlineMemory.keyDot k k = 1 →
    OnlineMemory.read S₁ k j ≠ OnlineMemory.read S₂ k j →
      OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite OnlineMemory.gdnIdealWrite ∧
        OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite OnlineMemory.emenderPreTanhWrite ∧
          ¬OnlineMemory.UniformOneStepOverwrite OnlineMemory.rawOuterWrite
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} S₁ S₂ k v j hunit hread =>
  ⟨OnlineMemory.gdnIdealWrite_uniformOneStepOverwrite,
    ⟨OnlineMemory.emenderPreTanhWrite_uniformOneStepOverwrite,
      OnlineMemory.rawOuterWrite_not_uniformOneStepOverwrite S₁ S₂ k v j hunit hread⟩⟩

theorems.source_text:
/-- NDM: Nonlinear Delta Memory.

This is the paper-facing model family: a pure nonlinear recurrent stack with
matrix state, input-dependent delta correction, and many independent recurrent
programs per token. E88 is the current production implementation lineage of
this family.
-/
def emender (layers heads nState : Nat) : ArchitectureSignature where
  name := "E88/NDM"
  stateGeometry := .matrix
  temporalNonlinearity := .fullState
  transitionSide := .left
  transitionControl := .inputDependent
  writeRule := .deltaCorrecting
  carryPlacement := .insideNonlinearity
  memorySemantics := .errorCorrectingAssociativeTable
  implementationMode := .sequentialManyProgram
  totalLayers := layers
  nonlinearTemporalLayers := layers
  headsPerLayer := heads
  stateScalarsPerHead := nState * nState
  pureRecurrentStack := true
  scanCompatible := false
theorems.signature: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → RecurrentResourceFormalism.ArchitectureSignature
theorems.proof_body:
fun layers heads nState =>
  { name := "E88/NDM", stateGeometry := RecurrentResourceFormalism.StateGeometry.matrix,
    temporalNonlinearity := RecurrentResourceFormalism.TemporalNonlinearity.fullState,
    transitionSide := RecurrentResourceFormalism.TransitionSide.left,
    transitionControl := RecurrentResourceFormalism.TransitionControl.inputDependent,
    writeRule := RecurrentResourceFormalism.WriteRule.deltaCorrecting,
    carryPlacement := RecurrentResourceFormalism.CarryPlacement.insideNonlinearity,
    memorySemantics := RecurrentResourceFormalism.MemorySemantics.errorCorrectingAssociativeTable,
    implementationMode := RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementationMode.sequentialManyProgram,
    totalLayers := layers, nonlinearTemporalLayers := layers, headsPerLayer := heads,
    stateScalarsPerHead := nState * nState, pureRecurrentStack := true, scanCompatible := false }
theorems.name: RecurrentResourceFormalism.emender

/-- E97 split-gated Nonlinear Delta Memory.

E97 keeps the E88/Emender square matrix state and full-state temporal
nonlinearity, but adds token-feature-derived split erase/read and write gates
inside the same delta-correcting update family. In this coarse resource
signature, the gates do not add an external recurrent-state carry. -/
def e97SplitGated (layers heads nState : Nat) : ArchitectureSignature where
  name := "E97 split-gated NDM"
  stateGeometry := .matrix
  temporalNonlinearity := .fullState
  transitionSide := .left
  transitionControl := .inputDependent
  writeRule := .deltaCorrecting
  carryPlacement := .insideNonlinearity
  memorySemantics := .errorCorrectingAssociativeTable
  implementationMode := .sequentialManyProgram
  totalLayers := layers
  nonlinearTemporalLayers := layers
  headsPerLayer := heads
  stateScalarsPerHead := nState * nState
  pureRecurrentStack := true
  scanCompatible := false

theorems.source_text:
/-- E88's expanded delta transition is genuinely key-dependent: two different
keys induce two different left-transition matrices.

This is the concrete core of the one-step transition-family separation. M2RNN's
learned right transition `W` is fixed across keys inside a layer; E88's delta
rule induces `lambda I - k k^T`, which changes with the current key. -/
theorem e88_two_keys_induce_distinct_left_transitions :
    M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition (K := 2) 1 key0 ≠
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition (K := 2) 1 key1 := by
  intro h
  have h00 := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M 0 0) h
  simp [M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition, M2RNNComparison.outerKV, key0, key1] at h00
theorems.signature:
M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 ≠
  M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1
theorems.proof_body:
fun h =>
  have h00 := congrArg (fun M => M 0 0) h;
  False.elim
    (Eq.mp
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun x => x 0 0)
                (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (one_smul ℝ 1))
                  (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                    (funext fun i =>
                      funext fun j =>
                        Eq.trans (mul_ite (j = 0) (if i = 0 then 1 else 0) 1 0)
                          (ite_congr (Eq.refl (j = 0)) (fun a => mul_one (if i = 0 then 1 else 0))
                            fun a => mul_zero (if i = 0 then 1 else 0))))))
              (Eq.trans
                (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (Matrix.one_apply_eq 0))
                  (Eq.trans (ite_cond_eq_true (if 0 = 0 then 1 else 0) 0 (eq_self 0))
                    (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self 0))))
                (sub_self 1))))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => x 0 0)
              (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (one_smul ℝ 1))
                (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                  (funext fun i =>
                    funext fun j =>
                      Eq.trans (mul_ite (j = 1) (if i = 1 then 1 else 0) 1 0)
                        (ite_congr (Eq.refl (j = 1)) (fun a => mul_one (if i = 1 then 1 else 0))
                          fun a => mul_zero (if i = 1 then 1 else 0))))))
            (Eq.trans
              (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (Matrix.one_apply_eq 0))
                (ite_cond_eq_false (if 0 = 1 then 1 else 0) 0 zero_ne_one._simp_1))
              (sub_zero 1))))
        zero_ne_one._simp_1)
      h00)

theorems.source_text:
/-- No fixed M2RNN right-transition matrix can make the M2RNN preactivation
family match E88's key-dependent delta preactivation for two basis keys.

This is the one-step transition-family version of the separation. M2RNN's
candidate path has a fixed right transition `W`; E88/NDM's expanded delta rule
has an input-dependent left transition `I - k kᵀ`. If the two families matched
for all states and values at both `key0` and `key1`, then testing on `H = I`
and `v = 0` would force the same fixed `W` to equal two distinct E88
transitions. -/
theorem no_fixed_m2rnn_preactivation_matches_e88_two_basis_keys
    (W : TwoMat) :
    ¬ ((∀ H v,
          m2rnnPreactivation2 W H key0 v =
            e88DeltaPreactivation2 H key0 v) ∧
       (∀ H v,
          m2rnnPreactivation2 W H key1 v =
            e88DeltaPreactivation2 H key1 v)) := by
  intro h
  have hw0 :
      W = M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition (K := 2) 1 key0 := by
    simpa [m2rnnPreactivation2, e88DeltaPreactivation2,
      M2RNNComparison.outerKV] using h.1 (1 : TwoMat) (0 : TwoVec)
  have hw1 :
      W = M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition (K := 2) 1 key1 := by
    simpa [m2rnnPreactivation2, e88DeltaPreactivation2,
      M2RNNComparison.outerKV] using h.2 (1 : TwoMat) (0 : TwoVec)
  exact no_fixed_transition_matches_e88_two_basis_keys W ⟨hw0, hw1⟩
theorems.signature:
∀ (W : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoMat),
  ¬((∀ (H : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoMat) (v : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoVec),
        RecurrentResourceFormalism.m2rnnPreactivation2 W H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v =
          RecurrentResourceFormalism.e88DeltaPreactivation2 H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v) ∧
      ∀ (H : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoMat) (v : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoVec),
        RecurrentResourceFormalism.m2rnnPreactivation2 W H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 v =
          RecurrentResourceFormalism.e88DeltaPreactivation2 H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 v)
theorems.proof_body:
fun W h =>
  have hw0 :=
    Eq.mp
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (one_mul W))
              (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero (RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 i)))))
          (congr
            (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
              (mul_one (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0)))
            (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
              (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero (RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 i)))))
        (mul_left_inj._simp_4 (Matrix.of fun i j => 0)))
      (h.left 1 0);
  have hw1 :=
    Eq.mp
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (one_mul W))
              (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero (RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 i)))))
          (congr
            (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
              (mul_one (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1)))
            (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
              (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero (RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 i)))))
        (mul_left_inj._simp_4 (Matrix.of fun i j => 0)))
      (h.right 1 0);
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.no_fixed_transition_matches_e88_two_basis_keys W ⟨hw0, hw1⟩
theorems.name: RecurrentResourceFormalism.no_fixed_m2rnn_preactivation_matches_e88_two_basis_keys
theorems.doc:
No fixed M2RNN right-transition matrix can make the M2RNN preactivation
family match E88's key-dependent delta preactivation for two basis keys.

This is the one-step transition-family version of the separation. M2RNN's
candidate path has a fixed right transition `W`; E88/NDM's expanded delta rule
has an input-dependent left transition `I - k kᵀ`. If the two families matched
for all states and values at both `key0` and `key1`, then testing on `H = I`

theorems.source_text:
/-- The same fixed-transition separation lifts through the `tanh` candidate
path. Since `tanh` is injective over reals, uniformly matching the M2RNN
candidate `tanh(H W + k vᵀ)` to the E88 candidate
`tanh((I - k kᵀ) H + k vᵀ)` would imply equality of the preactivations, which
the previous theorem rules out for two basis keys.

This still isolates the candidate path. The external M2RNN forget interpolation
is a further resource axis handled by later theorems. -/
theorem no_fixed_m2rnn_candidate_matches_e88_two_basis_keys
    (W : TwoMat) :
    ¬ ((∀ H v,
          M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate W H key0 v =
            M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H key0 v) ∧
       (∀ H v,
          M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate W H key1 v =
            M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H key1 v)) := by
  intro h
  apply no_fixed_m2rnn_preactivation_matches_e88_two_basis_keys W
  constructor
  · intro H v
    ext i j
    have hij := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M i j) (h.1 H v)
    have hpre := Activation.tanh_injective hij
    simpa [m2rnnPreactivation2, e88DeltaPreactivation2,
      M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate, M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded,
      M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh, M2RNNComparison.matrixMap] using hpre
  · intro H v
    ext i j
    have hij := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M i j) (h.2 H v)
    have hpre := Activation.tanh_injective hij
    simpa [m2rnnPreactivation2, e88DeltaPreactivation2,
      M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate, M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded,
      M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh, M2RNNComparison.matrixMap] using hpre
theorems.signature:
∀ (W : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoMat),
  ¬((∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState 2 2) (v : M2RNNComparison.Vec 2),
        M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate W H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v =
          M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v) ∧
      ∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState 2 2) (v : M2RNNComparison.Vec 2),
        M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate W H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 v =
          M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 v)
theorems.proof_body:
fun W h =>
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.no_fixed_m2rnn_preactivation_matches_e88_two_basis_keys W
    ⟨fun H v =>
      Matrix.ext fun i j =>
        have hij := congrArg (fun M => M i j) (h.left H v);
        have hpre := Activation.tanh_injective hij;
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (mul_left_inj._simp_4 (M2RNNComparison.outerKV RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v i j)))
          (Eq.mp
            (mul_left_inj._simp_4 (M2RNNComparison.outerKV RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v i j))
            hpre),
      fun H v =>
      Matrix.ext fun i j =>
        have hij := congrArg (fun M => M i j) (h.right H v);
        have hpre := Activation.tanh_injective hij;
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (mul_left_inj._simp_4 (M2RNNComparison.outerKV RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 v i j)))
          (Eq.mp
            (mul_left_inj._simp_4 (M2RNNComparison.outerKV RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 v i j))
            hpre)⟩

theorems.source_text:
/-- The two basis keys still induce distinct E88/NDM updates after the
elementwise `tanh` nonlinearity.

The witness fixes `H = I` and `v = 0`. The preactivations are just the two
key-dependent E88 transition matrices, and elementwise `tanh` is injective. -/
theorem e88_two_keys_induce_distinct_updates_at_identity_zero :
    M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 (1 : TwoMat) key0 (0 : TwoVec) ≠
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 (1 : TwoMat) key1 (0 : TwoVec) := by
  intro h
  apply e88_two_keys_induce_distinct_left_transitions
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M i j) h
  have hpre := Activation.tanh_injective hij
  simpa [M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded, M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh,
    M2RNNComparison.matrixMap, M2RNNComparison.outerKV] using hpre
theorems.signature:
M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 0 ≠
  M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 0
theorems.proof_body:
fun h =>
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.e88_two_keys_induce_distinct_left_transitions
    (Matrix.ext fun i j =>
      have hij := congrArg (fun M => M i j) h;
      have hpre := Activation.tanh_injective hij;
      Eq.mp
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun x => x i j)
                (congr
                  (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                    (mul_one
                      (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0)))
                  (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                    (funext fun i =>
                      funext fun j => mul_zero (RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 i)))))
              (add_zero
                (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 i j))))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => x i j)
              (congr
                (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                  (mul_one (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1)))
                (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                  (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero (RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 i)))))
            (add_zero (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.key1 i j))))
        hpre)
theorems.name: RecurrentResourceFormalism.e88_two_keys_induce_distinct_updates_at_identity_zero
theorems.doc:
The two basis keys still induce distinct E88/NDM updates after the
elementwise `tanh` nonlinearity.

The witness fixes `H = I` and `v = 0`. The preactivations are just the two

theorems.source_text:
/-- Adding M2RNN's external scalar forget carry does not remove the
fixed-transition separation.

For any fixed right-transition matrix `W` and scalar forget gate `f`, the full
M2RNN update

`f H + (1 - f) tanh(H W + k vᵀ)`

cannot uniformly match E88/NDM's expanded delta update for both basis keys. The
witness again sets `H = I` and `v = 0`: M2RNN's full update is identical for
`key0` and `key1`, because the key only appears through the zero raw-write term,
while E88's update remains key-dependent through `(I - k kᵀ) H`. -/
theorem no_fixed_m2rnn_update_matches_e88_two_basis_keys
    (W : TwoMat) (f : Real) :
    ¬ ((∀ H v,
          M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f H key0 v =
            M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H key0 v) ∧
       (∀ H v,
          M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f H key1 v =
            M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H key1 v)) := by
  intro h
  have hm2 :
      M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f (1 : TwoMat) key0 (0 : TwoVec) =
        M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f (1 : TwoMat) key1 (0 : TwoVec) := by
    simp [M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate,
      M2RNNComparison.outerKV]
  have he88 :
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 (1 : TwoMat) key0 (0 : TwoVec) =
        M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 (1 : TwoMat) key1 (0 : TwoVec) := by
    calc
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 (1 : TwoMat) key0 (0 : TwoVec)
          = M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f (1 : TwoMat) key0 (0 : TwoVec) :=
            (h.1 (1 : TwoMat) (0 : TwoVec)).symm
      _ = M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f (1 : TwoMat) key1 (0 : TwoVec) := hm2
      _ = M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 (1 : TwoMat) key1 (0 : TwoVec) :=
            h.2 (1 : TwoMat) (0 : TwoVec)
  exact e88_two_keys_induce_distinct_updates_at_identity_zero he88
theorems.signature:
∀ (W : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoMat) (f : ℝ),
  ¬((∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState 2 2) (v : M2RNNComparison.Vec 2),
        M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v =
          M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H RecurrentResourceFormalism.key0 v) ∧

theorems.doc:
Adding M2RNN's external scalar forget carry does not remove the
fixed-transition separation.

For any fixed right-transition matrix `W` and scalar forget gate `f`, the full
M2RNN update

`f H + (1 - f) tanh(H W + k vᵀ)`

cannot uniformly match E88/NDM's expanded delta update for both basis keys. The
witness again sets `H = I` and `v = 0`: M2RNN's full update is identical for
`key0` and `key1`, because the key only appears through the zero raw-write term,
while E88's update remains key-dependent through `(I - k kᵀ) H`.

/-- Even if the scalar M2RNN forget gate is allowed to depend on the input key,
the fixed-transition/scalar-carry update cannot uniformly match E88/NDM on the
two basis keys.

The key point is that matching writes from an empty state forces the scalar
forget gate to be `0` for each basis key: with `H = 0`, E88 writes
`tanh(k vᵀ)`, while M2RNN writes `(1 - f(k)) tanh(k vᵀ)`. Since `tanh(1) ≠ 0`,
uniform equality forces `f(key0) = f(key1) = 0`, reducing the claim to the
candidate-path separation above. -/
theorem no_fixed_m2rnn_update_with_key_scalar_forget_matches_e88_two_basis_keys
    (W : TwoMat) (f0 f1 : Real) :
    ¬ ((∀ H v,
          M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f0 H key0 v =
            M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H key0 v) ∧
       (∀ H v,
          M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate W f1 H key1 v =
            M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 H key1 v)) := by
  intro h
  have hf0 : f0 = 0 := by
    have hentry := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M 0 0) (h.1 (0 : TwoMat) key0)
    have hentry' : (1 - f0) * Real.tanh (1 : Real) = Real.tanh (1 : Real) := by
      simpa [M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate,
        M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded, M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition,
        M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh, M2RNNComparison.matrixMap,
        M2RNNComparison.outerKV, key0] using hentry
    have hmul : f0 * Real.tanh (1 : Real) = 0 := by nlinarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right tanh_one_ne_zero
  have hf1 : f1 = 0 := by
    have hentry := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M 1 1) (h.2 (0 : TwoMat) key1)
    have hentry' : (1 - f1) * Real.tanh (1 : Real) = Real.tanh (1 : Real) := by
      simpa [M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate,
        M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded, M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition,
        M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh, M2RNNComparison.matrixMap,
        M2RNNComparison.outerKV, key1] using hentry
    have hmul : f1 * Real.tanh (1 : Real) = 0 := by nlinarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right tanh_one_ne_zero
  apply no_fixed_m2rnn_candidate_matches_e88_two_basis_keys W
  constructor
  · intro H v
    simpa [hf0, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate] using h.1 H v
  · intro H v
    simpa [hf1, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnUpdate] using h.2 H v

theorems.name: RecurrentResourceFormalism.no_fixed_m2rnn_update_with_key_scalar_forget_matches_e88_two_basis_keys
theorems.doc:
Even if the scalar M2RNN forget gate is allowed to depend on the input key,
the fixed-transition/scalar-carry update cannot uniformly match E88/NDM on the
two basis keys.

The key point is that matching writes from an empty state forces the scalar
forget gate to be `0` for each basis key: with `H = 0`, E88 writes
`tanh(k vᵀ)`, while M2RNN writes `(1 - f(k)) tanh(k vᵀ)`. Since `tanh(1) ≠ 0`,
uniform equality forces `f(key0) = f(key1) = 0`, reducing the claim to the
candidate-path separation above.

theorems.source_text:
/-- A row-gated M2RNN external carry still cannot match E88/NDM's mixed-key
delta correction.

The witness fixes `k = (1, 1)`, `v = 0`, and a state whose first row is zero
but second row is nonzero. A fixed right transition `H W` is row-local: the
first output row depends only on the first input row, so the row-gated M2RNN
entry `(0,0)` is zero. E88's `(I - k kᵀ) H` subtracts the second row from the
first row, so the same entry is `tanh(-1)`. -/
theorem row_forget_m2rnn_fails_mixed_key_delta_correction
    (W : TwoMat) (r : TwoVec) :
    m2rnnRowForgetUpdate2 W r lowerLeftState mixedKey (0 : TwoVec) ≠
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 lowerLeftState mixedKey (0 : TwoVec) := by
  intro h
  have hentry := congrArg (fun M : TwoMat => M 0 0) h
  have hbad : Real.tanh (1 : Real) = 0 := by
    simpa [m2rnnRowForgetUpdate2, rowForgetCarry2, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate,
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded, M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition,
      M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh, M2RNNComparison.matrixMap,
      M2RNNComparison.outerKV, lowerLeftState, mixedKey, Matrix.mul_apply] using hentry
  exact tanh_one_ne_zero hbad

∀ (W : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoMat) (r : RecurrentResourceFormalism.TwoVec),
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.m2rnnRowForgetUpdate2 W r RecurrentResourceFormalism.lowerLeftState
      RecurrentResourceFormalism.mixedKey 0 ≠
    M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.lowerLeftState
      RecurrentResourceFormalism.mixedKey 0
theorems.proof_body:
fun W r h =>
  have hentry := congrArg (fun M => M 0 0) h;
  have hbad :=
    Eq.mp
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun x => Matrix.of x 0 0)
                (funext fun i =>
                  funext fun j =>
                    congr
                      (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                        (Eq.trans (mul_ite (i = 1) (r i) (if j = 0 then 1 else 0) 0)
                          (ite_congr (Eq.refl (i = 1))
                            (fun a =>
                              Eq.trans (mul_ite (j = 0) (r i) 1 0)
                                (ite_congr (Eq.refl (j = 0)) (fun a => mul_one (r i)) fun a =>
                                  mul_zero (r i)))
                            fun a => mul_zero (r i))))
                      (congrArg (fun x => (1 - r i) * Matrix.of x i j)
                        (funext fun i =>
                          funext fun j =>
                            congrArg Real.tanh
                              (Eq.trans
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun x =>
                                    ((Matrix.of fun i j =>
                                            if i = 1 then if j = 0 then 1 else 0 else 0) *
                                          W +
                                        Matrix.of x)
                                      i j)
                                  (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero 1))
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (congrArg (fun x => x + 0)
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (Eq.trans
                                        (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                                          Eq.trans
                                            (ite_mul (i = 1) (if x = 0 then 1 else 0) 0 (W x j))
                                            (ite_congr (Eq.refl (i = 1))
                                              (fun a =>
                                                Eq.trans (ite_mul (x = 0) 1 0 (W x j))
                                                  (ite_congr (Eq.refl (x = 0))
                                                    (fun a => one_mul (W x j)) fun a =>
                                                    zero_mul (W x j)))
                                              fun a => zero_mul (W x j)))
                                        (Finset.sum_ite_irrel (i = 1) Finset.univ
                                          (fun x => if x = 0 then W x j else 0) fun x => 0))
                                      (ite_congr (Eq.refl (i = 1))
                                        (fun a =>
                                          Eq.trans (Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ 0 fun x => W x j)
                                            (ite_cond_eq_true (W 0 j) 0
                                              (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 0)))
                                        fun a => Finset.sum_const_zero)))
                                  (add_zero (if i = 1 then W 0 j else 0))))))))
              (Eq.trans
                (congr
                  (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                    (ite_cond_eq_false (if 0 = 0 then r 0 else 0) 0 zero_ne_one._simp_1))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (HMul.hMul (1 - r 0))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg Real.tanh (ite_cond_eq_false (W 0 0) 0 zero_ne_one._simp_1))
                        Real.tanh_zero))
                    (mul_zero (1 - r 0))))
                (add_zero 0))))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => Matrix.of x 0 0)
              (funext fun i =>
                funext fun j =>
                  congrArg Real.tanh
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (fun x => x i j)
                        (congr
                          (congrArg
                            (fun x =>
                              HAdd.hAdd
                                (x *
                                  Matrix.of fun i j => if i = 1 then if j = 0 then 1 else 0 else 0))
                            (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (one_smul ℝ 1))
                              (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of) (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_one 1))))
                          (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of) (funext fun i => funext fun j => mul_zero 1))))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (fun x => x + 0)
                          (Eq.trans
                            (Eq.trans
                              (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a =>
                                Eq.trans (mul_ite (x = 1) (1 i x - 1) (if j = 0 then 1 else 0) 0)
                                  (ite_congr (Eq.refl (x = 1))
                                    (fun a =>
                                      Eq.trans (mul_ite (j = 0) (1 i x - 1) 1 0)
                                        (ite_congr (Eq.refl (j = 0)) (fun a => mul_one (1 i x - 1))
                                          fun a => mul_zero (1 i x - 1)))
                                    fun a => mul_zero (1 i x - 1)))
                              (Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ 1 fun x =>
                                if j = 0 then 1 i x - 1 else 0))
                            (ite_cond_eq_true (if j = 0 then 1 i 1 - 1 else 0) 0
                              (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 1))))
                        (add_zero (if j = 0 then 1 i 1 - 1 else 0))))))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg Real.tanh
                (Eq.trans (ite_cond_eq_true (1 0 1 - 1) 0 (eq_self 0))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (fun x => x - 1)
                      (Matrix.one_apply_ne
                        (of_eq_true
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg Not zero_ne_one._simp_1) not_false_eq_true))))
                    (zero_sub 1))))
              (Real.tanh_neg 1))))
        one_eq_inv._simp_4)
      hentry;
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.tanh_one_ne_zero hbad

theorems.doc:
Even cellwise external carry cannot repair the missing mixed-key delta
correction if the candidate path remains a fixed right transition plus raw
outer-product write. Cell gates can retain or replace cells, but they do not
create the cross-row term `-k kᵀ H` that E88/NDM applies before `tanh`.

theorems.source_text:
/-- The one-step mixed-key delta-correction target.

This target isolates the operation that E88/NDM gets from its input-dependent
left transition:

`H ↦ tanh((I - k kᵀ) H + k vᵀ)`.

At the witness state/key/value below, the correction moves information across
rows. A fixed-right-transition M2RNN candidate can mix columns within each row,
but cannot create this cross-row correction in one step; external row/column/cell
forget gates can only retain or replace already-computed cells. -/
def ImplementsMixedKeyDeltaCorrection
    (update : TwoMat → TwoVec → TwoVec → TwoMat) : Prop :=
  update lowerLeftState mixedKey (0 : TwoVec) =
    M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 lowerLeftState mixedKey (0 : TwoVec)

  Prop

fun update =>
  update RecurrentResourceFormalism.lowerLeftState RecurrentResourceFormalism.mixedKey 0 =
    M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1 RecurrentResourceFormalism.lowerLeftState
      RecurrentResourceFormalism.mixedKey 0

theorems.source_text:
/-- Main one-step resource separation:

E88/NDM implements the mixed-key delta correction in one recurrent step. The
M2RNN-style resource class with fixed right transition, raw outer write, and
external row/column/cell forget carry cannot implement that same target in one
step.

This is deliberately a one-step/resource theorem, not a broad computability
separation. It identifies the extra mechanism M2RNN would need to simulate E88:
an input-dependent left transition or additional resources/steps that recreate
the missing `-k kᵀ H` correction. -/
theorem emender_m2rnn_one_step_resource_separation :
    ImplementsMixedKeyDeltaCorrection (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1) ∧
    ∀ resource : FixedRightRawExternalForget2,
      ¬ ImplementsMixedKeyDeltaCorrection resource.update := by
  constructor
  · exact e88_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction
  · intro resource
    cases resource with
    | row W r =>
        exact row_forget_m2rnn_not_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction W r
    | column W c =>
        exact column_forget_m2rnn_not_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction W c
    | cell W g =>
        exact cell_forget_m2rnn_not_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction W g
theorems.signature:
RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementsMixedKeyDeltaCorrection
    (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1) ∧
  ∀ (resource : RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForget2),
    ¬RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementsMixedKeyDeltaCorrection resource.update
theorems.proof_body:
⟨RecurrentResourceFormalism.e88_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction, fun resource =>
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForget2.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
    resource = t → ¬RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementsMixedKeyDeltaCorrection resource.update)
    resource
    (fun W r h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        RecurrentResourceFormalism.row_forget_m2rnn_not_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction W r)
    (fun W c h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        RecurrentResourceFormalism.column_forget_m2rnn_not_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction W
          c)
    (fun W g h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        RecurrentResourceFormalism.cell_forget_m2rnn_not_implements_mixed_key_delta_correction W g)
    (Eq.refl resource)⟩

/-- The embedded two-direction mixed key in any key space of size at least two. -/
def embeddedMixedKey {K : Nat} (hK : 1 < K) : M2RNNComparison.Vec K :=
  fun i =>

    else if i = (⟨1, hK⟩ : Fin K) then 1
    else 0

/-- Row-gated fixed-right M2RNN cannot implement the embedded mixed-key
delta-correction target in any larger state space. -/
theorem row_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction
    {K V : Nat} (hK : 1 < K) (hV : 0 < V)
    (W : Matrix (Fin V) (Fin V) Real) (r : M2RNNComparison.Vec K) :
    ¬ ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection hK hV
      (m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV W r) := by
  intro h
  let i0 : Fin K := ⟨0, Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hK⟩
  let j0 : Fin V := ⟨0, hV⟩
  have hentry := congrArg (fun M : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V => M i0 j0) h
  have hbad : Real.tanh (1 : Real) = 0 := by
    simpa [ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection, m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV,
      rowForgetCarryKV, M2RNNComparison.m2rnnCandidate,
      M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded, M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaTransition,
      M2RNNComparison.matrixTanh, M2RNNComparison.matrixMap,
      M2RNNComparison.outerKV, embeddedLowerLeftState, embeddedMixedKey,
      Matrix.mul_apply, i0, j0] using hentry
  exact tanh_one_ne_zero hbad

      (RecurrentResourceFormalism.m2rnnRowForgetUpdateKV W r)

/-- General embedding theorem: the one-step separation is not a 2D artifact.

For every key dimension `K ≥ 2` and value dimension `V ≥ 1`, E88/NDM implements
the embedded mixed-key delta correction in one recurrent step, while every
fixed-right/raw-write M2RNN-style resource with external row/column/cell forget
fails on the embedded witness.
-/
theorem emender_m2rnn_one_step_resource_separation_embeds
    {K V : Nat} (hK : 1 < K) (hV : 0 < V) :
    ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection hK hV
      (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1) ∧
    ∀ resource : FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V,
      ¬ ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection hK hV resource.update := by
  constructor
  · exact e88_implements_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK hV
  · intro resource
    cases resource with
    | row W r =>
        exact row_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK hV W r
    | column W c =>
        exact column_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK hV W c
    | cell W g =>
        exact cell_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK hV W g
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (hV : 0 < V),
  RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection hK hV
      (M2RNNComparison.e88DeltaUpdateExpanded 1) ∧
    ∀ (resource : RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV K V),
      ¬RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection hK hV resource.update
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} hK hV =>
  ⟨RecurrentResourceFormalism.e88_implements_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK hV,
    fun resource =>
    RecurrentResourceFormalism.FixedRightRawExternalForgetKV.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
      resource = t →
        ¬RecurrentResourceFormalism.ImplementsEmbeddedMixedKeyDeltaCorrection hK hV resource.update)
      resource
      (fun W r h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸
          RecurrentResourceFormalism.row_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK
            hV W r)
      (fun W c h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸
          RecurrentResourceFormalism.column_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction
            hK hV W c)
      (fun W g h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸
          RecurrentResourceFormalism.cell_forget_m2rnn_fails_embedded_mixed_key_delta_correction hK
            hV W g)
      (Eq.refl resource)⟩

/-- Whether an architecture has an explicit external forget gate applied after
the nonlinear candidate (i.e., the carry is placed outside the nonlinearity).
`outsideNonlinearity`: M2RNN-style scalar, row, or column forget gate.
`residualReadout`: highway connection after the layer output.
All other carry placements (including `insideNonlinearity` for NDM) return
`false`. -/
def hasExternalForgetGate (a : ArchitectureSignature) : Bool :=
  match a.carryPlacement with
  | .outsideNonlinearity => true
  | .residualReadout     => true
  | _                    => false

/-- Per-head per-token FLOP count in the transparent cost model defined above.

- Without external forget gate: `6 * stateScalarsPerHead`

  if hasExternalForgetGate a
  then 7 * a.stateScalarsPerHead

/-- **F3 — Per-token FLOP class equivalence (Pillar 3 Lean anchor).**

For matched state dimension `d` (NDM state = d × d scalars, M2RNN state =
d × d scalars), head count `H`, and stack depth `depth`, the per-head
per-token FLOP costs are:

1. `flopsPerToken(NDM)    = 6 · d²`  (delta carry inside nonlinearity; no gate)
2. `flopsPerToken(M2RNN)  = 7 · d²`  (external forget gate adds one extra pass)
3. Both are bounded above by `7 · d²` (`c₁ = 7, c₂ = 0` in `c₁ · d² + c₂ · d`).
4. The two counts are within a factor of 2 of each other:
   `flopsPerToken(M2RNN) ≤ 2 · flopsPerToken(NDM)`.

Consequence: equal-token-budget comparisons at matched `(d, H, depth)` are not
confounded by this coarse per-head recurrent-state FLOP count.

This theorem makes no claim about learning-rate convergence, FLOPs-per-bit
convergence, or empirical superiority.  It is a pure combinatorial cost
statement. -/
theorem emender_m2rnn_flop_class_equiv (d H depth : Nat) :
    flopsPerToken (emender depth H d) = 6 * (d * d) ∧
    flopsPerToken (m2rnnPure depth H (d * d)) = 7 * (d * d) ∧
    flopsPerToken (emender depth H d) ≤ 7 * (d * d) ∧
    flopsPerToken (m2rnnPure depth H (d * d)) ≤ 7 * (d * d) ∧
    flopsPerToken (m2rnnPure depth H (d * d)) ≤ 2 * flopsPerToken (emender depth H d) := by
  have h1 : flopsPerToken (emender depth H d) = 6 * (d * d) := rfl
  have h2 : flopsPerToken (m2rnnPure depth H (d * d)) = 7 * (d * d) := rfl
  refine ⟨h1, h2, h1 ▸ ?_, h2 ▸ ?_, h2 ▸ h1 ▸ ?_⟩ <;>
    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (d * d)]

theorems.name: RecurrentResourceFormalism.emender_m2rnn_flop_class_equiv
theorems.doc:
**F3 — Per-token FLOP class equivalence (Pillar 3 Lean anchor).**

For matched state dimension `d` (NDM state = d × d scalars, M2RNN state =
d × d scalars), head count `H`, and stack depth `depth`, the per-head
per-token FLOP costs are:

1. `flopsPerToken(NDM)    = 6 · d²`  (delta carry inside nonlinearity; no gate)
2. `flopsPerToken(M2RNN)  = 7 · d²`  (external forget gate adds one extra pass)
3. Both are bounded above by `7 · d²` (`c₁ = 7, c₂ = 0` in `c₁ · d² + c₂ · d`).
4. The two counts are within a factor of 2 of each other:
   `flopsPerToken(M2RNN) ≤ 2 · flopsPerToken(NDM)`.

Consequence: equal-token-budget comparisons at matched `(d, H, depth)` are not
confounded by this coarse per-head recurrent-state FLOP count.

This theorem makes no claim about learning-rate convergence, FLOPs-per-bit
convergence, or empirical superiority.  It is a pure combinatorial cost
statement.

theorems.proof_body: fun d => d * d

    e97PerHeadStateUpdateCostCoarse d = e88PerHeadStateUpdateCost d := by

    e97PrecomputedSplitGateOverhead d = 2 * d := by
  rfl

  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right d hd

/-- With precomputed gates counted explicitly, E97 remains in the same
quadratic per-head cost class as E88 for square state dimension `d >= 2`.

The bound exposes the conservative constant: E88 is `6*d*d`, while E97 with
gate applications is at most `7*d*d`. This theorem does not include gate
generation from token features and does not claim improved empirical
efficiency. -/
