theorems.doc:
The 4 standard basis matrices of ℝ^{2×2} are all distinct.

These are 4 distinct E88 states (when D=2) that any mapping to E1H's
2-dimensional state space must collapse (pigeonhole: 4 states → 2 bins
means at least 2 states are indistinguishable by E1H).

theorems.source_text:
/-- **MAIN SUMMARY: All capacity separation results**

E88 strictly exceeds E1H in state capacity for D ≥ 2:
1. E88 has D² scalar entries per head (vs D for E1H)
2. E88 supports content-addressable retrieval S·q (E1H cannot)
3. E88 state separates from E1H: D < D² for D ≥ 2

This is the state capacity half of why E88 empirically outperforms E1H
(1.19 vs 1.10 perplexity at 32K tokens). -/
theorem e88_exceeds_e1h_capacity_summary (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≥ 2) :
    -- (1) E88 has D² scalar degrees of freedom per head
    Fintype.card (Fin d × Fin d) = d * d ∧
    -- (2) E1H has D scalar degrees of freedom per head
    Fintype.card (Fin d) = d ∧
    -- (3) E88 has strictly more DOF: D < D²
    Fintype.card (Fin d) < Fintype.card (Fin d × Fin d) ∧
    -- (4) Content-addressable: E88 can distinguish different queries; E1H cannot
    (∃ (S : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (q₁ q₂ : Fin d → ℝ),
      q₁ ≠ q₂ ∧ e88ContentRead S q₁ ≠ e88ContentRead S q₂) ∧
    -- (5) Scalar count separation: D < D² (proven via E1HDefinition)
    E1H.e1hStateScalarsPerHead d < E1H.e88StateScalarsPerHead d := by
  exact ⟨e88_capacity_d_squared d,
         e1h_capacity_d d,
         e88_dof_strictly_exceeds_e1h d hd,
         e88_addressable_e1h_not d hd,
         capacity_separation d hd⟩

/-- Inner product of two one-hot generator keys: `1` if the same generator,
otherwise `0`. -/
theorem keyDot_emenderKey (g g' : AdjacentGenerator) :
    keyDot (emenderKey g) (emenderKey g') =
      if g = g' then (1 : Real) else 0 := by
  unfold keyDot emenderKey
  by_cases hgg : g = g'
  · subst hgg
    simp only [if_true]
    -- Σᵢ (if i = genIndex g then 1 else 0) * (if i = genIndex g then 1 else 0)
    -- collapses to the single term at i = genIndex g.
    have h_eq :
        (fun i : Fin D =>
            (if i = genIndex g then (1 : Real) else 0) *
              (if i = genIndex g then (1 : Real) else 0)) =
          fun i : Fin D => if i = genIndex g then (1 : Real) else 0 := by
      funext i
      by_cases h : i = genIndex g
      · simp [h]
      · simp [h]
    rw [h_eq]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (genIndex g) (fun _ => (1 : Real))]
    simp
  · -- distinct generators: distinct positions, so every term in the sum is zero.
    simp only [hgg, if_false]
    have hne : genIndex g ≠ genIndex g' := fun h => hgg (genIndex_injective h)
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    by_cases h1 : i = genIndex g
    · subst h1
      simp [hne]
    · simp [h1]

                  (if_true 1 0))))
            (have h_eq :=
              funext fun i =>
                if h : i = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g then
                  of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congr
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans

                                (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0
                                  (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g) h)
                                    (eq_self (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g)))))
                              (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0
                                (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g) h)
                                  (eq_self (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g)))))
                            (mul_one 1)))
                        (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g) h)
                            (eq_self (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g)))))
                      (eq_self 1))
                else
                  of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congr
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false h)))
                              (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false h)))
                            (mul_zero 0)))
                        (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false h)))
                      (eq_self 0));
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Finset.univ.sum _a = 1) h_eq))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1)
                    (Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g) fun x => 1)))
                (of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (fun x => x = 1)
                      (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0 (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g))))
                    (eq_self 1)))))
      else
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (Eq
                (∑ i,

                    if i = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g' then 1 else 0))
              (Eq.trans (ite_congr (eq_false hgg) (fun a => Eq.refl 1) fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                (if_false 1 0))))
          (have hne := fun h => hgg (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex_injective h);
          Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i a =>
            if h1 : i = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g then

                i ∈ Finset.univ →

                      if i = NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g' then 1 else 0) =
                    0)

                        (Eq.trans

                              (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex g))))
                            (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false hne)))

                        (ite_self 0))))

/-- The `Fin 4`-indexed key family is orthonormal. -/
theorem emenderKeyFin_orthonormal : OrthonormalKeys emenderKeyFin := by
  intro i j
  unfold emenderKeyFin
  rw [keyDot_emenderKey]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; simp
  · have hne : fin4ToGenerator i ≠ fin4ToGenerator j := by
      intro h
      apply hij
      have := congrArg generatorToFin4 h
      rw [generatorToFin4_fin4ToGenerator, generatorToFin4_fin4ToGenerator] at this
      exact this
    simp [hij, hne]
theorems.signature: OnlineMemory.OrthonormalKeys NDMRealizesS5.emenderKeyFin
theorems.proof_body:
fun i j =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = if i = j then 1 else 0)
          (NDMRealizesS5.keyDot_emenderKey (NDMRealizesS5.fin4ToGenerator i)
            (NDMRealizesS5.fin4ToGenerator j))))
      (if hij : i = j then
        hij ▸
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self (NDMRealizesS5.fin4ToGenerator i))))
                (ite_cond_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self i)))
              (eq_self 1))
      else
        have hne := fun h =>
          hij
            (have this := congrArg NDMRealizesS5.generatorToFin4 h;
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => i = _a) (NDMRealizesS5.generatorToFin4_fin4ToGenerator j))
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a => _a = NDMRealizesS5.generatorToFin4 (NDMRealizesS5.fin4ToGenerator j))
                  (NDMRealizesS5.generatorToFin4_fin4ToGenerator i))
                this));
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr (congrArg Eq (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false hne)))
              (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false hij)))
            (eq_self 0))))

theorems.doc: The `Fin 4`-indexed key family is orthonormal.

  intro a b hab
  by_contra hne

  rw [emenderValue_at_genIndex_self, emenderValue_at_genIndex_other a b hne] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h

          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue b (NDMRealizesS5.genIndex a))

/-- Decode a value vector back to its adjacent transposition. For the four
expected inputs `emenderValue g`, this returns `transposition g`; on any other
vector the decoder returns the identity permutation.

This is the "decoder" half of the linear readout pipeline. The decoder is
noncomputable because it tests real-valued vector equality, which uses
classical logic. The downstream theorems only rely on its behavior on the
four `emenderValue g` inputs. -/
noncomputable def decode (vec : ValueVec D) : S5Tracker.State :=
  letI : Decidable (vec = emenderValue .s01) := Classical.propDecidable _
  letI : Decidable (vec = emenderValue .s12) := Classical.propDecidable _
  letI : Decidable (vec = emenderValue .s23) := Classical.propDecidable _
  letI : Decidable (vec = emenderValue .s34) := Classical.propDecidable _
  if vec = emenderValue .s01 then transposition .s01
  else if vec = emenderValue .s12 then transposition .s12
  else if vec = emenderValue .s23 then transposition .s23
  else if vec = emenderValue .s34 then transposition .s34
  else (1 : S5Tracker.State)
theorems.signature: OnlineMemory.ValueVec NDMRealizesS5.D → S5Tracker.State

fun vec =>
  if vec = NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01 then
    S5Tracker.transposition S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01
  else
    if vec = NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12 then
      S5Tracker.transposition S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12
    else
      if vec = NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s23 then
        S5Tracker.transposition S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s23
      else
        if vec = NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s34 then
          S5Tracker.transposition S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s34
        else 1

theorem decode_emenderValue (g : AdjacentGenerator) :
    decode (emenderValue g) = transposition g := by
  cases g with
  | s01 =>
    unfold decode
    simp
  | s12 =>
    unfold decode
    simp [emenderValue_s12_ne_s01]
  | s23 =>
    unfold decode
    simp [emenderValue_s23_ne_s01, emenderValue_s23_ne_s12]
  | s34 =>
    unfold decode
    simp [emenderValue_s34_ne_s01, emenderValue_s34_ne_s12, emenderValue_s34_ne_s23]

    (fun h =>

                (Eq.trans

                      else

                          S5Tracker.transposition S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s34

/-- Querying the loaded memory at `emenderKey g` recovers exactly `emenderValue g`. -/
theorem loadedMemory_read_emenderKey (g : AdjacentGenerator) :
    read loadedMemory (emenderKey g) = emenderValue g := by
  have hself : emenderKey g = emenderKeyFin (generatorToFin4 g) := by
    unfold emenderKeyFin
    rw [fin4ToGenerator_generatorToFin4]
  have hvalself : emenderValue g = emenderValueFin (generatorToFin4 g) := by
    unfold emenderValueFin
    rw [fin4ToGenerator_generatorToFin4]
  rw [hself, hvalself]
  exact memoryTable_retrieves_orthonormal
    emenderKeyFin emenderValueFin emenderKeyFin_orthonormal (generatorToFin4 g)

fun g =>
  have hself :=

/-- Reading the zero memory at any key returns the zero vector. -/
theorem read_zero (k : KeyVec D) : read (0 : Memory D D) k = 0 := by
  change M2RNNComparison.queryReadout (0 : Memory D D) k = 0
  funext j
  simp [M2RNNComparison.queryReadout, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

fun k =>
  id
    (funext fun j =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun x => x = 0)
            (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => zero_mul (k x))
              Finset.sum_const_zero))

/-- Pre-tanh delta write from the zero memory with a unit key is exactly the
outer product `k vᵀ`. This is the base case for the trajectory bridge. -/
theorem linearDeltaWrite_from_zero (g : AdjacentGenerator) :
    linearDeltaWrite (0 : Memory D D) (emenderKey g) (emenderValue g) =
      M2RNNComparison.outerKV (emenderKey g) (emenderValue g) := by
  unfold linearDeltaWrite correction
  rw [read_zero]
  simp
theorems.signature:
∀ (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite 0 (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g) =
    M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)
theorems.proof_body:
fun g =>
  id
    (id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              0 +
                  M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                    (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g - _a) =
                M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g))
            (NDMRealizesS5.read_zero (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g))))
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg
              (fun x =>
                x =
                  M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                    (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (fun x => 0 + M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) x)
                  (sub_zero (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)))
                (zero_add
                  (M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                    (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)))))
            (eq_self
              (M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)))))))

theorems.source_text:
/-- For an orthonormal key family, applying one `linearDeltaWrite` for a NEW
orthogonal unit key (one whose readout into the current memory is zero) adds
that key's outer-product term and preserves all existing entries.

This is the induction step behind the trajectory bridge: the loaded memory
after writing all generators equals the sum of outer-product terms. -/
theorem linearDeltaWrite_add_orthonormal_term
    (S : Memory D D) (g : AdjacentGenerator)
    (hread : read S (emenderKey g) = 0) :
    linearDeltaWrite S (emenderKey g) (emenderValue g) =
      S + M2RNNComparison.outerKV (emenderKey g) (emenderValue g) := by
  unfold linearDeltaWrite correction
  rw [hread]
  simp
theorems.signature:
∀ (S : OnlineMemory.Memory NDMRealizesS5.D NDMRealizesS5.D) (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  OnlineMemory.read S (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) = 0 →
    OnlineMemory.linearDeltaWrite S (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g) =
      S + M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)
theorems.proof_body:
fun S g hread =>
  id
    (id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              S +
                  M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                    (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g - _a) =
                S +
                  M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                    (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g))
            hread))
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg
              (fun x =>
                S + M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g) x =
                  S +
                    M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                      (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g))
              (sub_zero (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)))
            (eq_self
              (S +
                M2RNNComparison.outerKV (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)
                  (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)))))))

/-- **`emender_realizes_s5_tracker`** — the load-bearing NDM-architecture
realization of the S5 transition table.

There exist:
* an integer `d = 12` (sufficient orthonormal headroom for four generators),
* an orthonormal key family `k : Fin 4 → KeyVec d` (the `Fin 4` indexing is
  the canonical `AdjacentGenerator ≃ Fin 4` bijection via `fin4ToGenerator`),
* a value family `v : Fin 4 → ValueVec d`,
* a decay scalar `λ = 1`,
* a per-generator linear readout query family
  `q : AdjacentGenerator → KeyVec d` (concretely `q g = emenderKey g`),
* and a decoder `decode : ValueVec d → S5Tracker.State`,

such that for every input pair `(s, g)`, the NDM delta-memory readout
(`queryReadout · q g`) at the loaded orthonormal memory table `memoryTable k v`,
decoded and composed with `s`, reproduces the S5 transition table entry
`s5TransitionMemory.read (s, g) = step s g`.

The loaded memory is exactly the state reached by running the NDM pre-`tanh`
delta-write core through any input word that touches each adjacent generator
exactly once (per-step bridge: `linearDeltaWrite_add_orthonormal_term`;
per-generator readout: `loadedMemory_read_emenderKey`).

This is the formal version of the paper's revised wording: *"NDM reaches the
top of NC1 in the canonical regular-language witness"* (S5 word problem,
non-solvable, NC1-complete by Barrington's theorem cited externally). -/
theorem emender_realizes_s5_tracker :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (k : Fin 4 → KeyVec d)
      (v : Fin 4 → ValueVec d) (lambda : Real)
      (q : AdjacentGenerator → KeyVec d)
      (decode : ValueVec d → S5Tracker.State),
      d = 12 ∧
      lambda = 1 ∧
      OrthonormalKeys k ∧
      (∀ g, q g = k (generatorToFin4 g)) ∧
      (∀ g, decode (v (generatorToFin4 g)) = transposition g) ∧
      (∀ (s : S5Tracker.State) (g : AdjacentGenerator),
        s * decode (read (memoryTable k v) (q g)) =
          s5TransitionMemory.read (s, g)) := by
  refine ⟨D, emenderKeyFin, emenderValueFin, 1, emenderKey, decode,
    rfl, rfl, emenderKeyFin_orthonormal, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g
    unfold emenderKeyFin
    rw [fin4ToGenerator_generatorToFin4]
  · intro g
    have hval : emenderValueFin (generatorToFin4 g) = emenderValue g := by
      unfold emenderValueFin
      rw [fin4ToGenerator_generatorToFin4]
    rw [hval]
    exact decode_emenderValue g
  · intro s g
    -- read (memoryTable emenderKeyFin emenderValueFin) (emenderKey g) = emenderValue g
    have : memoryTable emenderKeyFin emenderValueFin = loadedMemory := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact loadedMemory_implements_s5_lookup s g
theorems.signature:
∃ d k v lambda q decode,
  d = 12 ∧
    lambda = 1 ∧
      OnlineMemory.OrthonormalKeys k ∧
        (∀ (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator), q g = k (NDMRealizesS5.generatorToFin4 g)) ∧
          (∀ (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
              decode (v (NDMRealizesS5.generatorToFin4 g)) = S5Tracker.transposition g) ∧
            ∀ (s : S5Tracker.State) (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
              s * decode (OnlineMemory.read (OnlineMemory.memoryTable k v) (q g)) =
                S5NDMRealization.s5TransitionMemory.read (s, g)
theorems.proof_body:
Exists.intro NDMRealizesS5.D
  (Exists.intro NDMRealizesS5.emenderKeyFin
    (Exists.intro NDMRealizesS5.emenderValueFin
      (Exists.intro 1
        (Exists.intro NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey
          (Exists.intro NDMRealizesS5.decode
            ⟨rfl,
              ⟨rfl,
                ⟨NDMRealizesS5.emenderKeyFin_orthonormal,
                  ⟨fun g =>
                    id
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a => NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g = NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey _a)
                            (NDMRealizesS5.fin4ToGenerator_generatorToFin4 g)))
                        (Eq.refl (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g))),
                    ⟨fun g =>
                      have hval :=
                        id
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue _a = NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)
                                (NDMRealizesS5.fin4ToGenerator_generatorToFin4 g)))
                            (Eq.refl (NDMRealizesS5.emenderValue g)));
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => NDMRealizesS5.decode _a = S5Tracker.transposition g)
                            hval))
                        (NDMRealizesS5.decode_emenderValue g),
                      fun s g =>
                      have this := rfl;
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              s *
                                  NDMRealizesS5.decode
                                    (OnlineMemory.read _a (NDMRealizesS5.emenderKey g)) =
                                S5NDMRealization.s5TransitionMemory.read (s, g))
                            this))
                        (NDMRealizesS5.loadedMemory_implements_s5_lookup s g)⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩)))))

/-- The GDN matrix state produced by running a per-token schedule over a word,
starting from the zero state. -/

    MatState K V :=

/-- Folding a concatenated parameter schedule splits at the prefix. -/
theorem gdnStateFold_append (s t : List (GdnStepParams K V)) (H : MatState K V) :
    gdnStateFold (s ++ t) H = gdnStateFold t (gdnStateFold s H) := by
  induction s generalizing H with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih => exact ih (gdnStep p H)

∀ {K V : ℕ} (s t : List (CompositionalDepthDuality.GdnStepParams K V))
  (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
  CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (s ++ t) H =
    CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold t (CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold s H)
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} s t H =>
  List.rec (motive := fun s =>
    ∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
      CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (s ++ t) H =
        CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold t (CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold s H))
    (fun H => Eq.refl (CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold ([] ++ t) H))
    (fun p ps ih H => ih (CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStep p H)) s H

/-- **The GDN run over a concatenated word splits at the prefix.** This is the
word-level form of `gdnStateFold_append`: processing `u ++ v` is processing `v`
from the state reached after `u`. -/
theorem gdnRun_append (params : GdnSchedule K V) (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator) :
    gdnRun params (u ++ v) = gdnStateFold (v.map params) (gdnRun params u) := by
  unfold gdnRun
  rw [List.map_append]
  exact gdnStateFold_append (u.map params) (v.map params) 0

theorems.source_text:
/-- **Composing two word-actions of a GDN state channel returns an affine map
with no additional nonlinear layer.** If folding a schedule `s` is the affine
map `A * · + C` and folding `t` is `B * · + D`, then folding `s ++ t` is
`(B * A) * · + (B * C + D)`. The linear parts multiply and the constants add;
no elementwise nonlinearity is introduced by longer words. This is the concrete
sense in which the GDN state channel has zero nonlinear temporal depth, in
contrast with the E97/E88 update, which adds one `tanh` layer per time step
(`CompositionalDepthDuality.e97_compositional_depth_grows_in_time`). -/
theorem gdnStateFold_affine_compose
    (A B : Matrix (Fin K) (Fin K) Real) (C D : MatState K V)
    (s t : List (GdnStepParams K V))
    (hs : ∀ H, gdnStateFold s H = A * H + C)
    (ht : ∀ H, gdnStateFold t H = B * H + D) :
    ∀ H, gdnStateFold (s ++ t) H = (B * A) * H + (B * C + D) := by
  intro H
  rw [gdnStateFold_append, ht, hs, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin K) (Fin K) ℝ) (C D : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V)
  (s t : List (CompositionalDepthDuality.GdnStepParams K V)),
  (∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V), CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold s H = A * H + C) →
    (∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V), CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold t H = B * H + D) →
      ∀ (H : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
        CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (s ++ t) H = B * A * H + (B * C + D)
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} A B C D s t hs ht H =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = B * A * H + (B * C + D)) (S5GDNBridge.gdnStateFold_append s t H)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = B * A * H + (B * C + D))
          (ht (CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold s H))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => B * _a + D = B * A * H + (B * C + D)) (hs H)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a + D = B * A * H + (B * C + D)) (Matrix.mul_add B (A * H) C)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a + B * C + D = B * A * H + (B * C + D))
                (Eq.symm (Matrix.mul_assoc B A H))))
            (Eq.trans
              (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.subst_into_addg (B * A * H + B * C) D
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * A * H) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0))
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * A * H)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)))
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.subst_into_addg (B * A * H) (B * C)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * A * H) 0)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * A * H) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_atomg (B * A * H))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_atomg (B * C))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_add_constg 1 (B * A * H) 0
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0)
                    (zero_add (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0))))
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_atomg D)
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_add_constg 1 (B * A * H)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_add_constg 1 (B * C) 0 (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)
                    (zero_add (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)))))
              (Eq.symm
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.subst_into_addg (B * A * H) (B * C + D)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * A * H) 0)
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * A * H)
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_atomg (B * A * H))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.subst_into_addg (B * C) D
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) 0) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_atomg (B * C)) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_atomg D)
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_add_constg 1 (B * C) 0
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)
                      (zero_add (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0))))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.term_add_constg 1 (B * A * H) 0
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C) (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0))
                    (zero_add
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 (B * C)
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Abel.termg 1 D 0)))))))))))

theorems.source_text:
/-- A GDN-family model realizes the S5 tracker: a per-token parameter schedule,
a decoder from the carried matrix state to `S5`, and the realization equation
`decode (gdnRun params w) = S5Tracker.run w` on every word.

`separates` is the injectivity-on-the-reachable-image condition: the decoder must
not glue together two reachable states. It is the strongest injectivity that can
be asked of a map from the uncountable matrix state space into the 120-element
`S5`, and it is what makes the factorization theorem below go through. -/
structure GdnRealizesS5 (K V : Nat) where
  /-- Per-token GDN gate/value/decay schedule. -/
  params : GdnSchedule K V
  /-- Decoder from the carried matrix state to `S5`. -/
  decode : MatState K V → S5Tracker.State
  /-- Realization: the decoded run reproduces the S5 tracker on every word. -/
  realizes : ∀ w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator, decode (gdnRun params w) = S5Tracker.run w
  /-- The decoder separates reachable states. -/
  separates : ∀ u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator,
    decode (gdnRun params u) = decode (gdnRun params v) → gdnRun params u = gdnRun params v
theorems.signature: ℕ → ℕ → Type

theorems.source_text:
/-- **The word-level GDN state map factors through the S5 element.** Two words
with the same S5 product — e.g. two spellings of the same permutation, or the
two words of the relation `s01 s12 ≠ s12 s01` — reach the same GDN state. This
is candidate (a)'s core: exact realization forces the per-token parameter family
to realize the transition-monoid action, since distinct words cannot be
distinguished by the state channel beyond their S5 product. -/
theorem gdn_realization_factors_through_s5 (R : GdnRealizesS5 K V)
    (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator) :
    S5Tracker.run u = S5Tracker.run v → gdnRun R.params u = gdnRun R.params v := by
  intro h
  apply R.separates
  rw [R.realizes u, R.realizes v, h]
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (R : S5GDNBridge.GdnRealizesS5 K V) (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  S5Tracker.run u = S5Tracker.run v → S5GDNBridge.gdnRun R.params u = S5GDNBridge.gdnRun R.params v
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} R u v h =>
  R.separates u v
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = R.decode (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun R.params v)) (R.realizes u)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => S5Tracker.run u = _a) (R.realizes v)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = S5Tracker.run v) h)) (Eq.refl (S5Tracker.run v)))))

/-- The word-level state is the canonical function of the S5 element alone. -/

/-- **The per-token fold implements right multiplication by the S5 element.**
Running the schedule for a suffix `v` from the state of `run u` returns the state
of `run u * run v`: the GDN per-token maps realize the right S5-action on the
reachable state image. -/
theorem gdn_word_action_is_right_multiplication (R : GdnRealizesS5 K V)
    (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator) :
    gdnStateFold (v.map R.params) (s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u)) =
      s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v) := by
  rw [← gdnRun_eq_s5StateOf R u, ← gdnRun_append R.params u v, gdnRun_eq_s5StateOf,
    S5Tracker.run_append]
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (R : S5GDNBridge.GdnRealizesS5 K V) (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (List.map R.params v)
      (S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u)) =
    S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v)
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} R u v =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (List.map R.params v) _a =
            S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v))
        (Eq.symm (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun_eq_s5StateOf R u))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v))
          (Eq.symm (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun_append R.params u v))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v))
            (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun_eq_s5StateOf R (u ++ v))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R _a =
                  S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v))
              (S5Tracker.run_append u v)))
          (Eq.refl (S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v))))))

theorems.source_text:
/-- **`gdn_s5_realization_requires_per_token_action`.**

A GDN-family model that realizes the S5 tracker induces a function
`F : S5 → MatState` such that:

1. the word-level state map factors through the S5 element
   (`gdnRun params w = F (run w)`) — the per-token parameter family must realize
   the S5 transition-monoid action;
2. the per-token fold acts as right multiplication by the S5 element on the
   reachable image;
3. every such action is affine in the state (`A * · + C`), because the state
   channel carries no nonlinear temporal composition.

Reading: the recurrent state channel is affine (zero nonlinear temporal depth);
token-independent parameters are impossible
(`gdn_s5_constant_parameters_cannot_realize`); therefore the whole S5 action must
be routed through the per-token gate/value functions. See the module docstring
for the precise limits of this claim (it is a routing statement, not a
circuit-depth lower bound). -/
theorem gdn_s5_realization_requires_per_token_action (R : GdnRealizesS5 K V) :
    ∃ F : S5Tracker.State → MatState K V,
      (∀ w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator, gdnRun R.params w = F (S5Tracker.run w)) ∧
      (∀ u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator,
        gdnStateFold (v.map R.params) (F (S5Tracker.run u)) =
          F (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v)) ∧
      (∀ v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator,
        ∃ A : Matrix (Fin K) (Fin K) Real, ∃ C : MatState K V,
          ∀ init : MatState K V, gdnStateFold (v.map R.params) init = A * init + C) := by
  refine ⟨s5StateOf R, gdnRun_eq_s5StateOf R, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u v
    exact gdn_word_action_is_right_multiplication R u v
  · intro v
    exact gdn_word_action_affine R.params v
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (R : S5GDNBridge.GdnRealizesS5 K V),
  ∃ F,
    (∀ (w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
        S5GDNBridge.gdnRun R.params w = F (S5Tracker.run w)) ∧
      (∀ (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
          CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (List.map R.params v) (F (S5Tracker.run u)) =
            F (S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v)) ∧
        ∀ (v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
          ∃ A C,
            ∀ (init : M2RNNComparison.MatState K V),
              CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold (List.map R.params v) init = A * init + C
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} R =>
  Exists.intro (S5GDNBridge.s5StateOf R)
    ⟨S5GDNBridge.gdnRun_eq_s5StateOf R,
      ⟨fun u v => S5GDNBridge.gdn_word_action_is_right_multiplication R u v, fun v =>
        S5GDNBridge.gdn_word_action_affine R.params v⟩⟩

/-- The adjacent transpositions `(0 1)` and `(1 2)` do not commute: the S5
tracker produces different states for `[s01, s12]` and `[s12, s01]`. -/
theorem s5_run_s01s12_ne_s12s01 :
    S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12] ≠
      S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01] := by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun p : S5Tracker.State => p (0 : Fin 5)) h
  simp [S5Tracker.run, S5Tracker.runFrom, S5Tracker.step, S5Tracker.transposition,
    Equiv.swap_apply_def, Equiv.swap_apply_left] at h0
theorems.signature:
S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12] ≠
  S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01]
theorems.proof_body:
fun h =>
  have h0 := congrArg (fun p => p 0) h;
  False.elim
    (Eq.mp
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun x => (List.foldl S5Tracker.step x [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12]) 0)
                (one_mul (Equiv.swap 0 1)))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (⇑(Equiv.swap 0 1))
                  (Eq.trans (ite_cond_eq_false 2 (if 0 = 2 then 1 else 0) zero_ne_one._simp_1)
                    (ite_cond_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false_of_decide (Eq.refl false)))))
                (Equiv.swap_apply_left 0 1))))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => (List.foldl S5Tracker.step x [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01]) 0)
              (one_mul (Equiv.swap 1 2)))
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(Equiv.swap 1 2)) (Equiv.swap_apply_left 0 1))
              (Equiv.swap_apply_left 1 2))))
        (eq_false_of_decide (Eq.refl false)))
      h0)

theorems.source_text:
/-- **A GDN schedule with token-independent parameters cannot realize the S5
tracker.** If every token maps to the same one-step parameters, the two words
`[s01, s12]` and `[s12, s01]` yield the same GDN state, but the S5 tracker
distinguishes them; hence no decoder can recover `S5Tracker.run`. Combined with
`gdn_s5_realization_requires_per_token_action` this shows the per-token
dependence is not decorative: without it the state channel alone provably
fails. -/
theorem gdn_s5_constant_parameters_cannot_realize
    (params : GdnSchedule K V) (hconst : ∃ p : GdnStepParams K V, ∀ g, params g = p) :
    ¬ ∃ decode : MatState K V → S5Tracker.State,
      ∀ w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator, decode (gdnRun params w) = S5Tracker.run w := by
  rintro ⟨decode, hdec⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hconst
  have hmap1 :
      ([S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12] :
        List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator).map params = [p, p] := by
    simp [hp]
  have hmap2 :
      ([S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01] :
        List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator).map params = [p, p] := by
    simp [hp]
  have hstate :
      gdnRun params [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12] =
        gdnRun params [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01] := by
    unfold gdnRun
    rw [hmap1, hmap2]
  have hrun :
      S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12] =
        S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01] := by
    rw [← hdec [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12],
      ← hdec [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01], hstate]
  exact s5_run_s01s12_ne_s12s01 hrun
theorems.signature:
∀ {K V : ℕ} (params : S5GDNBridge.GdnSchedule K V),
  (∃ p, ∀ (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator), params g = p) →
    ¬∃ decode,
        ∀ (w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
          decode (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun params w) = S5Tracker.run w
theorems.proof_body:
fun {K V} params hconst a =>
  Exists.casesOn a fun decode hdec =>
    Exists.casesOn hconst fun p hp =>
      have hmap1 :=
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => x = [p, p])
              (congr (congrArg List.cons ((fun g => hp g) S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01))
                (congrArg (fun x => [x]) ((fun g => hp g) S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12))))
            (eq_self [p, p]));
      have hmap2 :=
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => x = [p, p])
              (congr (congrArg List.cons ((fun g => hp g) S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12))
                (congrArg (fun x => [x]) ((fun g => hp g) S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01))))
            (eq_self [p, p]));
      have hstate :=
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold _a 0 =
                    CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold
                      (List.map params
                        [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01])
                      0)
                hmap1))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold [p, p] 0 =
                      CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold _a 0)
                  hmap2))
              (Eq.refl (CompositionalDepthDuality.gdnStateFold [p, p] 0))));
      have hrun :=
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a =
                  S5Tracker.run [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01])
              (Eq.symm (hdec [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12]))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  decode
                      (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun params
                        [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12]) =
                    _a)
                (Eq.symm
                  (hdec [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01]))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    decode _a =
                      decode
                        (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun params
                          [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01]))
                  hstate))
              (Eq.refl
                (decode
                  (S5GDNBridge.gdnRun params
                    [S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s12, S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.s01])))));
      S5GDNBridge.s5_run_s01s12_ne_s12s01 hrun

/-- The exact transition memory simulates the recognizer on every word. -/
theorem exactTransitionMemory_run
    {Alphabet : Type*}
    (M : S5Witness.FixedPrecisionOnlineRecognizer Alphabet)
    (w : List Alphabet) :
    lookupRun M (exactTransitionMemory M) w = M.run w := by
  induction w generalizing M with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
      change lookupRun
          { M with init := M.step M.init a }
          (exactTransitionMemory { M with init := M.step M.init a }) as =
        S5Witness.FixedPrecisionOnlineRecognizer.run
          { M with init := M.step M.init a } as
      exact ih { M with init := M.step M.init a }

  S5NDMRealization.lookupRun M (S5NDMRealization.exactTransitionMemory M) w = M.run w

fun {Alphabet} M w =>
  List.rec (motive := fun w =>
    ∀ (M : S5Witness.FixedPrecisionOnlineRecognizer Alphabet),
      S5NDMRealization.lookupRun M (S5NDMRealization.exactTransitionMemory M) w = M.run w)
    (fun M => Eq.refl (S5NDMRealization.lookupRun M (S5NDMRealization.exactTransitionMemory M) []))
    (fun a as ih M =>
      id
        (ih
          { State := M.State, stateFintype := M.stateFintype,
            stateDecidableEq := M.stateDecidableEq, init := M.step M.init a, step := M.step,
            accept := M.accept }))
    w M

/-- Running from `p` composes `p` with the product of the input word. -/
theorem runFrom_eq_mul_run (p : State) (w : List AdjacentGenerator) :
    runFrom p w = p * run w := by
  induction w generalizing p with
  | nil =>
      simp [runFrom, run]
  | cons g gs ih =>
      change runFrom (p * transposition g) gs =
        p * runFrom (transposition g) gs
      rw [ih (p * transposition g), ih (transposition g)]
      simp [mul_assoc]
theorems.signature:
∀ (p : S5Tracker.State) (w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  S5Tracker.runFrom p w = p * S5Tracker.run w
theorems.proof_body:
fun p w =>
  List.rec (motive := fun w => ∀ (p : S5Tracker.State), S5Tracker.runFrom p w = p * S5Tracker.run w)
    (fun p => of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq p) (mul_one p)) (eq_self p)))
    (fun g gs ih p =>
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = p * S5Tracker.runFrom (S5Tracker.transposition g) gs)
              (ih (p * S5Tracker.transposition g))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => p * S5Tracker.transposition g * S5Tracker.run gs = p * _a)
                (ih (S5Tracker.transposition g))))
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (fun x => x = p * (S5Tracker.transposition g * S5Tracker.run gs))
                  (mul_assoc p (S5Tracker.transposition g) (S5Tracker.run gs)))
                (eq_self (p * (S5Tracker.transposition g * S5Tracker.run gs))))))))
    w p
theorems.name: S5Tracker.runFrom_eq_mul_run
theorems.doc: Running from `p` composes `p` with the product of the input word.

/-- Concatenating input words composes their tracked S5 products. -/
theorem run_append (u v : List AdjacentGenerator) :
    run (u ++ v) = run u * run v := by
  calc
    run (u ++ v) = runFrom (run u) v := by
      simp [run, runFrom]
    _ = run u * run v := runFrom_eq_mul_run (run u) v
theorems.signature:
∀ (u v : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  S5Tracker.run (u ++ v) = S5Tracker.run u * S5Tracker.run v
theorems.proof_body:
fun u v =>
  Trans.trans
    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun x => x = List.foldl S5Tracker.step (List.foldl S5Tracker.step 1 u) v)
          List.foldl_append)
        (eq_self (List.foldl S5Tracker.step (List.foldl S5Tracker.step 1 u) v))))
    (S5Tracker.runFrom_eq_mul_run (S5Tracker.run u) v)
theorems.name: S5Tracker.run_append
theorems.doc: Concatenating input words composes their tracked S5 products.

/-- Appending one token composes by that token's adjacent transposition. -/
theorem run_concat (w : List AdjacentGenerator) (g : AdjacentGenerator) :
    run (w ++ [g]) = run w * transposition g := by
  simpa [run] using (show runFrom 1 (w ++ [g]) = run w * transposition g by
    calc
      runFrom 1 (w ++ [g]) = runFrom (run w) [g] := by
        simp [run, runFrom]
      _ = run w * transposition g := by
        rfl)
theorems.signature:
∀ (w : List S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator) (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  S5Tracker.run (w ++ [g]) = S5Tracker.run w * S5Tracker.transposition g
theorems.proof_body:
fun w g =>
  id
    (have this :=
      Trans.trans
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => x = S5Tracker.step (List.foldl S5Tracker.step 1 w) g)
              List.foldl_append)
            (eq_self (S5Tracker.step (List.foldl S5Tracker.step 1 w) g))))
        (Eq.refl (S5Tracker.runFrom (S5Tracker.run w) [g]));
    this)
theorems.name: S5Tracker.run_concat
theorems.doc: Appending one token composes by that token's adjacent transposition.

theorems.source_text:
/-- One Python tuple update is exactly one Lean S5 tracker step. -/
theorem pythonApplySwap_eq_step_tuple (p : State) (g : AdjacentGenerator) :
    pythonApplySwap (toPythonTuple p) g = toPythonTuple (step p g) := by
  funext i
  cases g <;>
    simp [pythonApplySwap, tupleSwap, toPythonTuple, step, transposition,
      Equiv.Perm.mul_def, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
theorems.signature:
∀ (p : S5Tracker.State) (g : S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator),
  S5Tracker.pythonApplySwap (S5Tracker.toPythonTuple p) g =
    S5Tracker.toPythonTuple (S5Tracker.step p g)
theorems.proof_body:
fun p g =>
  funext fun i =>
    S5Tracker.AdjacentGenerator.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
      g = t →
        S5Tracker.pythonApplySwap (S5Tracker.toPythonTuple p) g i =
          S5Tracker.toPythonTuple (S5Tracker.step p g) i)
      g
      (fun h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun x => x = p (if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then 0 else i))
                (ite_congr (Eq.refl (i = 0)) (fun a => Eq.refl (p 1)) fun a =>
                  ite_congr (Eq.refl (i = 1)) (fun a => Eq.refl (p 0)) fun a => Eq.refl (p i))))
            (if h : i = 0 then
              Eq.mpr (id (congr (congrArg Eq (if_pos h)) (congrArg (⇑p) (if_pos h))))
                (Eq.refl (p 1))
            else
              Eq.mpr (id (congr (congrArg Eq (if_neg h)) (congrArg (⇑p) (if_neg h))))
                (if h : i = 1 then

/-- Python-style tuple execution agrees with Lean tracker execution from every
S5 state. -/
theorem pythonRunFrom_eq_tracker_tuple
    (p : State) (w : List AdjacentGenerator) :
    pythonRunFrom (toPythonTuple p) w = toPythonTuple (runFrom p w) := by
  induction w generalizing p with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons g gs ih =>
      change pythonRunFrom (pythonApplySwap (toPythonTuple p) g) gs =
        toPythonTuple (runFrom (step p g) gs)
      rw [pythonApplySwap_eq_step_tuple]
      exact ih (step p g)

    ∀ (p : S5Tracker.State),

    (fun p => Eq.refl (S5Tracker.pythonRunFrom (S5Tracker.toPythonTuple p) []))

theorem runningTargetsFrom_length
    (p : State) (w : List AdjacentGenerator) :
    (runningTargetsFrom p w).length = w.length := by
  induction w generalizing p with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons g gs ih =>
      simp [runningTargetsFrom, ih]

  (S5Tracker.runningTargetsFrom p w).length = w.length

fun p w =>
  List.rec (motive := fun w =>
    ∀ (p : S5Tracker.State), (S5Tracker.runningTargetsFrom p w).length = w.length)
    (fun p => Eq.refl (S5Tracker.runningTargetsFrom p []).length)
    (fun g gs ih p =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => x + 1 = gs.length + 1) ((fun p => ih p) (S5Tracker.step p g)))
            Nat.add_left_cancel_iff._simp_1)
          (eq_self 1)))
    w p
